title: "Complex functions"
subtitle: "Differentiability in the complex plane and the Cauchy-Riemann equations"
chapter: 1
volume: 7

axiom: "Complex numbers extend the real line to a plane. Functions of a complex variable map that plane to itself. The condition for a complex function to be differentiable — the Cauchy-Riemann equations — is far more restrictive than real differentiability, and functions that satisfy it have extraordinary properties: infinitely differentiable, representable by power series, and connected to the solutions of Laplace's equation."

rewrite: "A complex function f(z) = u(x,y) + iv(x,y) is differentiable at z₀ if the limit of [f(z)−f(z₀)]/(z−z₀) exists regardless of how z approaches z₀. This requires u_x = v_y and u_y = −v_x (the Cauchy-Riemann equations). Functions that are differentiable throughout an open domain are analytic. The real and imaginary parts of any analytic function are harmonic — they satisfy Laplace's equation — which connects complex analysis to potential theory, heat conduction, and fluid flow."

  the left half-plane mean the system decays to equilibrium; a pole that
  crosses into the right half-plane means the system response grows
  without bound — oscillating if the pole is complex, diverging
  exponentially if it is real. The complex plane is not an abstraction
  — it is the natural space where the dynamics of the system live.

A function $f$ of a complex variable maps complex numbers to complex numbers. Writing $z = x + iy$ and separating $f(z) = u(x,y) + iv(x,y)$, the function is a pair of real-valued functions of two real variables. The condition on $u$ and $v$ that makes $f$ genuinely complex-differentiable — the Cauchy-Riemann equations — is what the rest of the chapter develops.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  // Stability half-plane explorer
  // s-plane with green (Re<0) and red (Re>0) half-planes
  // Draggable pole s (via sliders)
  // Inset: time response Re(e^{st}) plotted for t in [0, 5]

  const W = 560, H = 280, SCALE = 65, CX = 170, CY = H/2;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  const sReSl = Inputs.range([-2.5, 2.5], { value: -1.0, step: 0.1, label: "Re(s) — pole real part" });
  const sImSl = Inputs.range([-3.0, 3.0], { value: 1.5, step: 0.1, label: "Im(s) — pole imaginary part" });

  function buildViz(sRe, sIm) {
    const svg = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width",W); svg.setAttribute("height",H);
    svg.style.cssText="background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";

    // Left half: s-plane (x in [0,340] roughly)
    const PLANE_W = 340;

    // Green / red half-plane fills
    const axX = CX; // screen x for Re(s)=0
    const greenRect = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"rect");
    greenRect.setAttribute("x","0"); greenRect.setAttribute("y","0");
    greenRect.setAttribute("width",axX.toString()); greenRect.setAttribute("height",H);
    greenRect.setAttribute("fill","#059669"); greenRect.setAttribute("opacity","0.12");
    svg.appendChild(greenRect);

    const redRect = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"rect");
    redRect.setAttribute("x",axX.toString()); redRect.setAttribute("y","0");
    redRect.setAttribute("width",(PLANE_W-axX).toString()); redRect.setAttribute("height",H);
    redRect.setAttribute("fill","#dc2626"); redRect.setAttribute("opacity","0.12");
    svg.appendChild(redRect);

    // Grid lines (s-plane)
    for (let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
      const xl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
      const lx=CX+i*SCALE;
      xl.setAttribute("x1",lx); xl.setAttribute("y1","0"); xl.setAttribute("x2",lx); xl.setAttribute("y2",H);
      xl.setAttribute("stroke","#e5e7eb"); xl.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.5"); svg.appendChild(xl);
      const yl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
      const ly=CY-i*SCALE;
      yl.setAttribute("x1","0"); yl.setAttribute("y1",ly); yl.setAttribute("x2",PLANE_W); yl.setAttribute("y2",ly);
      yl.setAttribute("stroke","#e5e7eb"); yl.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.5"); svg.appendChild(yl);
    }

    // Imaginary axis (stability boundary)
    const axLine=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
    axLine.setAttribute("x1",axX); axLine.setAttribute("y1","0"); axLine.setAttribute("x2",axX); axLine.setAttribute("y2",H);
    axLine.setAttribute("stroke","#374151"); axLine.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");
    axLine.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray","6,3"); svg.appendChild(axLine);

    // Real axis
    const reAx=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
    reAx.setAttribute("x1","0"); reAx.setAttribute("y1",CY); reAx.setAttribute("x2",PLANE_W); reAx.setAttribute("y2",CY);
    reAx.setAttribute("stroke","#9ca3af"); reAx.setAttribute("stroke-width","1"); svg.appendChild(reAx);

    // Half-plane labels
    function addTxt(svg,x,y,txt,color,size,bold){
      const t=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
      t.setAttribute("x",x);t.setAttribute("y",y);t.setAttribute("fill",color);
      t.setAttribute("font-size",size||"11");t.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");
      t.setAttribute("text-anchor","middle"); if(bold) t.setAttribute("font-weight","bold");
      t.textContent=txt; svg.appendChild(t);
    }
    addTxt(svg,axX/2,22,"STABLE","#059669","12",true);
    addTxt(svg,axX/2,36,"Re(s) < 0","#059669","10");
    addTxt(svg,axX+(PLANE_W-axX)/2,22,"UNSTABLE","#dc2626","12",true);
    addTxt(svg,axX+(PLANE_W-axX)/2,36,"Re(s) > 0","#dc2626","10");

    // Pole marker
    const psx = CX + sRe*SCALE, psy = CY - sIm*SCALE;
    const inBounds = psx>0 && psx<PLANE_W && psy>0 && psy<H;

    if (inBounds) {
      // Cross marker (×)
      const cSize=7;
      const poleL1=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
      poleL1.setAttribute("x1",psx-cSize);poleL1.setAttribute("y1",psy-cSize);
      poleL1.setAttribute("x2",psx+cSize);poleL1.setAttribute("y2",psy+cSize);
      poleL1.setAttribute("stroke","#f97316");poleL1.setAttribute("stroke-width","2.5");
      svg.appendChild(poleL1);
      const poleL2=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
      poleL2.setAttribute("x1",psx+cSize);poleL2.setAttribute("y1",psy-cSize);
      poleL2.setAttribute("x2",psx-cSize);poleL2.setAttribute("y2",psy+cSize);
      poleL2.setAttribute("stroke","#f97316");poleL2.setAttribute("stroke-width","2.5");
      svg.appendChild(poleL2);

      const stable = sRe < 0;
      const poleColor = stable ? "#059669" : "#dc2626";
      const poleLbl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
      poleLbl.setAttribute("x",psx+10); poleLbl.setAttribute("y",psy-6);
      poleLbl.setAttribute("fill",poleColor); poleLbl.setAttribute("font-size","11");
      poleLbl.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");
      poleLbl.textContent=`s = ${sRe.toFixed(1)}${sIm>=0?"+":""}${sIm.toFixed(1)}i`;
      svg.appendChild(poleLbl);
    }

    // Axis labels
    addTxt(svg,PLANE_W-16,CY-4,"σ","#374151","11");
    addTxt(svg,axX+4,10,"jω","#374151","11");
    addTxt(svg,axX-16,10,"s-plane","#6b7280","10");

    // Right panel: time response Re(e^{st}) for t in [0,5]
    const PLOT_X = PLANE_W + 20, PLOT_W = W - PLANE_W - 30, PLOT_H = H - 40;
    const PLOT_Y = 20;
    const tMax = 5, numT = 200;

    // Collect time response
    const yVals = [];
    for (let k=0; k<=numT; k++) {
      const t = (k/numT)*tMax;
      // Re(e^{st}) = e^{σt} * cos(ωt)
      const y = Math.exp(sRe*t) * Math.cos(sIm*t);
      yVals.push(y);
    }
    // Auto-scale y
    let yMin=-2, yMax=2;
    const finite = yVals.filter(v=>isFinite(v));
    if (finite.length>0) {
      yMin = Math.min(yMin, ...finite.slice(-20));
      yMax = Math.max(yMax, ...finite.slice(-20));
    }
    const yRange = yMax-yMin || 1;

    // Plot background
    const plotBg=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"rect");
    plotBg.setAttribute("x",PLOT_X); plotBg.setAttribute("y",PLOT_Y);
    plotBg.setAttribute("width",PLOT_W); plotBg.setAttribute("height",PLOT_H);
    plotBg.setAttribute("fill","#f8fafc"); plotBg.setAttribute("rx","3");
    svg.appendChild(plotBg);

    // Zero line
    const zeroY = PLOT_Y + PLOT_H * (1 - (0-yMin)/yRange);
    const zeroLine=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
    zeroLine.setAttribute("x1",PLOT_X); zeroLine.setAttribute("y1",zeroY);
    zeroLine.setAttribute("x2",PLOT_X+PLOT_W); zeroLine.setAttribute("y2",zeroY);
    zeroLine.setAttribute("stroke","#9ca3af"); zeroLine.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.8");
    zeroLine.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray","3,2"); svg.appendChild(zeroLine);

    // Response curve
    let pathD="";
    for (let k=0; k<=numT; k++) {
      const t=(k/numT)*tMax;
      const y=yVals[k];
      const px=PLOT_X + (t/tMax)*PLOT_W;
      const py=PLOT_Y + PLOT_H*(1-(y-yMin)/yRange);
      const clampedPy = Math.max(PLOT_Y, Math.min(PLOT_Y+PLOT_H, py));
      pathD += (k===0 ? `M ${px} ${clampedPy}` : ` L ${px} ${clampedPy}`);
    }
    const respPath=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"path");
    respPath.setAttribute("d",pathD); respPath.setAttribute("fill","none");
    const stable2 = sRe < 0;
    respPath.setAttribute("stroke", stable2 ? "#059669" : "#dc2626");
    respPath.setAttribute("stroke-width","2"); svg.appendChild(respPath);

    // Plot labels
    addTxt(svg,PLOT_X+PLOT_W/2,PLOT_Y-6,"Time response Re(e^{st})","#374151","10.5",true);
    addTxt(svg,PLOT_X+PLOT_W,PLOT_Y+PLOT_H+14,"t","#6b7280","10");
    addTxt(svg,PLOT_X-4,PLOT_Y+PLOT_H/2,"y","#6b7280","10");

    return svg;
  }

  const container=document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText="border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0;";

  const titleEl=document.createElement("div");
  titleEl.style.cssText="font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem; font-family:sans-serif;";
  titleEl.textContent="Stability half-plane: poles in the s-plane";
  container.appendChild(titleEl);
  container.appendChild(sReSl);
  container.appendChild(sImSl);

  const vizDiv=document.createElement("div"); container.appendChild(vizDiv);

  const noteEl=document.createElement("div");
  noteEl.style.cssText="margin-top:0.4rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
  noteEl.textContent="The s-plane is the domain of the Laplace transform. The imaginary axis (dashed) is the stability boundary. Drag the × pole marker: left half-plane (green) → response decays; right half-plane (red) → response grows. A complex pole s = σ ± jω gives oscillation at rate ω, decaying if σ < 0 and growing if σ > 0. A real pole (Im = 0) gives pure exponential behaviour with no oscillation.";
  container.appendChild(noteEl);

  function update(){
    vizDiv.innerHTML="";
    vizDiv.appendChild(buildViz(sReSl.value, sImSl.value));
  }
  sReSl.addEventListener("input",update);
  sImSl.addEventListener("input",update);
  update();
  return container;
}
```

## Complex numbers: brief review

Every complex number $z = x + iy$ is a point in the **Argand plane**, with real part $x$ on the horizontal axis and imaginary part $y$ on the vertical.

**Polar form.** $z = r e^{i\theta}$, where $r = |z| = \sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ is the modulus and $\theta = \arg z$ is the argument — the angle from the positive real axis, measured counterclockwise. Euler's formula $e^{i\theta} = \cos\theta + i\sin\theta$ connects the polar and rectangular forms.

**De Moivre's theorem.** $(re^{i\theta})^n = r^n e^{in\theta}$. Integer powers of complex numbers are most efficiently computed in polar form.

**Conjugate.** $\bar{z} = x - iy$. Identities: $z\bar{z} = |z|^2$; $\text{Re}(z) = (z+\bar{z})/2$; $\text{Im}(z) = (z-\bar{z})/(2i)$.

<!-- VIZ OPPORTUNITY 1: Complex multiplication as rotation and scaling. Two controlled points z (draggable) and w = r·e^{iθ}, product zw computed automatically. Sliders for r and θ. -->

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const W = 420, H = 420, CX = W/2, CY = H/2, SCALE = 80;

  const rSlider = Inputs.range([0.5, 2.0], {value: 1.4, step: 0.05, label: "|w| = r"});
  const thetaSlider = Inputs.range([0, 2*Math.PI], {value: Math.PI/4, step: Math.PI/12, label: "arg(w) = θ"});

  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  function makeViz(r, theta) {
    // z starts at (1.2, 0.6) in complex coords
    let zx = 1.2, zy = 0.6;
    // w = r * e^{i theta}
    let wx = r * Math.cos(theta), wy = r * Math.sin(theta);
    // zw = z * w
    let zwx = zx*wx - zy*wy, zwy = zx*wy + zy*wx;

    function toScreen(cx, cy) {
      return [CX + cx*SCALE, CY - cy*SCALE];
    }

    const [zsx, zsy] = toScreen(zx, zy);
    const [zwsx, zwsy] = toScreen(zwx, zwy);

    const svg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width", W);
    svg.setAttribute("height", H);
    svg.style.cssText = "background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";

    // Grid
    const gridG = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "g");
    gridG.setAttribute("stroke", "#e5e7eb");
    gridG.setAttribute("stroke-width", "0.5");
    for (let i = -4; i <= 4; i++) {
      const xLine = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
      const [lx] = toScreen(i, 0); const [,ly1] = toScreen(0, -4); const [,ly2] = toScreen(0, 4);
      xLine.setAttribute("x1", lx); xLine.setAttribute("y1", ly1); xLine.setAttribute("x2", lx); xLine.setAttribute("y2", ly2);
      gridG.appendChild(xLine);
      const yLine = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
      const [lx1] = toScreen(-4, 0); const [lx2] = toScreen(4, 0); const [,ley] = toScreen(0, i);
      yLine.setAttribute("x1", lx1); yLine.setAttribute("y1", ley); yLine.setAttribute("x2", lx2); yLine.setAttribute("y2", ley);
      gridG.appendChild(yLine);
    }
    svg.appendChild(gridG);

    // Axes
    const axG = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "g");
    axG.setAttribute("stroke", "#9ca3af"); axG.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1");
    const xax = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
    const [ax1] = toScreen(-3.8, 0); const [ax2] = toScreen(3.8, 0); const [,axy] = toScreen(0, 0);
    xax.setAttribute("x1", ax1); xax.setAttribute("y1", axy); xax.setAttribute("x2", ax2); xax.setAttribute("y2", axy);
    const yax = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
    const [ayx] = toScreen(0, 0); const [,ay1] = toScreen(0, -3.8); const [,ay2] = toScreen(0, 3.8);
    yax.setAttribute("x1", ayx); yax.setAttribute("y1", ay1); yax.setAttribute("x2", ayx); yax.setAttribute("y2", ay2);
    axG.appendChild(xax); axG.appendChild(yax);
    svg.appendChild(axG);

    // Radial arms from origin to z and zw
    function makeLine(x1,y1,x2,y2,color,dash) {
      const l = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "line");
      l.setAttribute("x1",x1); l.setAttribute("y1",y1); l.setAttribute("x2",x2); l.setAttribute("y2",y2);
      l.setAttribute("stroke", color); l.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");
      if (dash) l.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", dash);
      return l;
    }
    const [ox, oy] = toScreen(0,0);
    svg.appendChild(makeLine(ox, oy, zsx, zsy, "#f97316", ""));
    svg.appendChild(makeLine(ox, oy, zwsx, zwsy, "#3b82f6", ""));

    // Arc showing rotation angle theta between z and zw arms
    const zAngle = Math.atan2(-zsy + CY, zsx - CX); // angle of z from screen center
    const zwAngle = Math.atan2(-zwsy + CY, zwsx - CX);
    const arcR = 30;
    const arcPath = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "path");
    // arc from zAngle to zwAngle
    const ax0 = CX + arcR * Math.cos(zAngle), ay0 = CY + arcR * Math.sin(zAngle);
    const ax1e = CX + arcR * Math.cos(zwAngle), ay1e = CY + arcR * Math.sin(zwAngle);
    // Choose large-arc-flag based on angular difference
    let dang = zwAngle - zAngle;
    while (dang > Math.PI) dang -= 2*Math.PI;
    while (dang < -Math.PI) dang += 2*Math.PI;
    const laf = Math.abs(dang) > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
    const swf = dang > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    arcPath.setAttribute("d", `M ${ax0} ${ay0} A ${arcR} ${arcR} 0 ${laf} ${swf} ${ax1e} ${ay1e}`);
    arcPath.setAttribute("fill","none"); arcPath.setAttribute("stroke","#8b5cf6");
    arcPath.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");
    svg.appendChild(arcPath);

    // Scale indicator: show |zw| / |z| = r label
    const zmag = Math.sqrt(zx*zx + zy*zy);
    const zwmag = Math.sqrt(zwx*zwx + zwy*zwy);

    // Points
    function makeCircle(px, py, radius, fill, stroke) {
      const c = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "circle");
      c.setAttribute("cx", px); c.setAttribute("cy", py); c.setAttribute("r", radius);
      c.setAttribute("fill", fill); c.setAttribute("stroke", stroke); c.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");
      return c;
    }
    svg.appendChild(makeCircle(zsx, zsy, 7, "#f97316", "#fff"));
    svg.appendChild(makeCircle(zwsx, zwsy, 7, "#3b82f6", "#fff"));
    svg.appendChild(makeCircle(ox, oy, 4, "#6b7280", "#fff"));

    // Labels
    function makeText(x, y, txt, color, size) {
      const t = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "text");
      t.setAttribute("x", x); t.setAttribute("y", y);
      t.setAttribute("fill", color); t.setAttribute("font-size", size || "12");
      t.setAttribute("font-family", "sans-serif");
      t.textContent = txt;
      return t;
    }
    svg.appendChild(makeText(zsx+8, zsy-6, "z", "#f97316", "13"));
    svg.appendChild(makeText(zwsx+8, zwsy-6, "zw", "#3b82f6", "13"));
    svg.appendChild(makeText(ox+4, oy-5, "O", "#6b7280", "11"));

    // Annotation
    const midArcX = CX + arcR * Math.cos((zAngle+zwAngle)/2);
    const midArcY = CY + arcR * Math.sin((zAngle+zwAngle)/2);
    svg.appendChild(makeText(midArcX - 5, midArcY - 8, "\u03b8", "#8b5cf6", "12"));

    // Info panel
    const info = document.createElement("div");
    info.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.85em; color:#374151; font-family:sans-serif; display:flex; gap:1.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap;";
    const thetaDeg = (theta * 180 / Math.PI).toFixed(0);
    info.innerHTML = `
      <span style="color:#f97316">|z| = ${zmag.toFixed(2)}</span>
      <span style="color:#3b82f6">|zw| = ${zwmag.toFixed(2)}</span>
      <span style="color:#8b5cf6">arg(w) = ${thetaDeg}°</span>
      <span style="color:#6b7280">|zw|/|z| = ${r.toFixed(2)} = r</span>
    `;

    const note = document.createElement("div");
    note.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.4rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
    note.textContent = `Multiplying by w = r·e^{iθ} rotates z by θ = ${thetaDeg}° and scales by r = ${r.toFixed(2)}. Orange point z, blue point zw. Set r = 1 for pure rotation; θ = 0 for pure scaling.`;

    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.style.cssText = "margin:1rem 0;";
    wrap.appendChild(svg);
    wrap.appendChild(info);
    wrap.appendChild(note);
    return wrap;
  }

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0;";

  const title = document.createElement("div");
  title.style.cssText = "font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem; font-family:sans-serif;";
  title.textContent = "Complex multiplication as rotation and scaling";
  container.appendChild(title);

  container.appendChild(rSlider);
  container.appendChild(thetaSlider);

  const vizContainer = document.createElement("div");
  container.appendChild(vizContainer);

  function update() {
    const r = rSlider.value;
    const theta = thetaSlider.value;
    vizContainer.innerHTML = "";
    vizContainer.appendChild(makeViz(r, theta));
  }

  rSlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  thetaSlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  update();

  return container;
}
```

---

## Complex functions

A complex function $f: \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ maps each $z = x+iy$ to a complex value $f(z) = u(x,y) + iv(x,y)$.

**Example.** $f(z) = z^2 = (x+iy)^2 = (x^2-y^2) + 2ixy$, so $u = x^2-y^2$, $v = 2xy$.

**Example.** $f(z) = \bar{z} = x - iy$, so $u = x$, $v = -y$. This function is nowhere differentiable in the complex sense — a consequence of the Cauchy-Riemann equations derived in the next section.

Limits and continuity work exactly as in real analysis, with one additional clause: $f$ is **continuous at $z_0$** if $\lim_{z\to z_0}f(z) = f(z_0)$, where the limit must be the same from every direction of approach.

---

## Complex differentiability

The **derivative** of $f$ at $z_0$ is:

$$f'(z_0) = \lim_{z \to z_0} \frac{f(z) - f(z_0)}{z - z_0}$$

The limit must exist and agree no matter how $z$ approaches $z_0$ — a far stronger requirement than real differentiability.

### Deriving the Cauchy-Riemann equations

The key idea is that the limit $[f(z)-f(z_0)]/(z-z_0)$ must give the same answer regardless of the direction of approach. The two simplest directions — horizontal and vertical — already force a constraint on $u$ and $v$.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  // Static two-panel approach-direction illustration
  // Left: z₀ with horizontal (orange) and vertical (blue) approach arrows
  // Right: the two difference quotient vectors in f-space
  const W = 290, H = 240, SCALE = 60, CX = W/2, CY = H/2;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  // Fixed example: f(z) = z², z₀ = 0.7 + 0.5i, Δ = 0.4
  const z0x=0.7, z0y=0.5, delta=0.4;

  function evalF(re,im){ return [re*re-im*im, 2*re*im]; }
  function toScreen(re,im){ return [CX+re*SCALE, CY-im*SCALE]; }

  function makeSVG(title) {
    const svg=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width",W); svg.setAttribute("height",H);
    svg.style.cssText="background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";
    for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){

      xl.setAttribute("stroke","#e5e7eb");xl.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.5");svg.appendChild(xl);
      const yl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line"); const [,ly]=toScreen(0,i);

      yl.setAttribute("stroke","#e5e7eb");yl.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.5");svg.appendChild(yl);
    }

    const dx=x2-x1,dy=y2-y1,len=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)||1; const ux=dx/len,uy=dy/len; const sz=8;
    const tri=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"polygon");
    tri.setAttribute("points",`${x2},${y2} ${x2-ux*sz+uy*sz*0.4},${y2-uy*sz-ux*sz*0.4} ${x2-ux*sz-uy*sz*0.4},${y2-uy*sz+ux*sz*0.4}`);
    tri.setAttribute("fill",color); svg.appendChild(tri);
  }

  function dot(svg,cx,cy,r,fill){ const c=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"circle"); c.setAttribute("cx",cx);c.setAttribute("cy",cy);c.setAttribute("r",r);c.setAttribute("fill",fill);c.setAttribute("stroke","#fff");c.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");svg.appendChild(c); }
  function lbl(svg,x,y,txt,color,size){ const t=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text"); t.setAttribute("x",x);t.setAttribute("y",y);t.setAttribute("fill",color);t.setAttribute("font-size",size||"11");t.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");t.textContent=txt;svg.appendChild(t); }

  // Left panel: z-plane
  const svgL = makeSVG("z-plane");
  const [z0sx,z0sy]=toScreen(z0x,z0y);
  // Horizontal approach: from z₀+Δ to z₀
  const [hsx]=toScreen(z0x+delta,z0y);
  arrow(svgL,hsx,z0sy,z0sx,z0sy,"#f97316");
  lbl(svgL,hsx+3,z0sy-5,"z₀+Δ","#f97316","10");
  // Vertical approach: from z₀+iΔ to z₀
  const [,vsy]=toScreen(z0x,z0y+delta);
  arrow(svgL,z0sx,vsy,z0sx,z0sy,"#3b82f6");
  lbl(svgL,z0sx+4,vsy-4,"z₀+iΔ","#3b82f6","10");
  dot(svgL,z0sx,z0sy,6,"#f97316");
  lbl(svgL,z0sx+8,z0sy-6,"z₀","#f97316","12");

  // Right panel: f-space difference quotient vectors
  const svgR = makeSVG("f(z)-space: quotient vectors");
  const f0=evalF(z0x,z0y);
  const fH=evalF(z0x+delta,z0y);
  const fV=evalF(z0x,z0y+delta);
  // Horizontal quotient: (f(z₀+Δ)-f(z₀))/Δ
  const hqr=(fH[0]-f0[0])/delta, hqi=(fH[1]-f0[1])/delta;
  // Vertical quotient: (f(z₀+iΔ)-f(z₀))/(iΔ) = -i*(Δf/Δ)
  const vqr=(fV[1]-f0[1])/delta, vqi=-(fV[0]-f0[0])/delta;
  const [origx,origy]=toScreen(0,0);
  const [hqsx,hqsy]=toScreen(hqr,hqi);
  const [vqsx,vqsy]=toScreen(vqr,vqi);
  arrow(svgR,origx,origy,hqsx,hqsy,"#f97316");
  lbl(svgR,hqsx+5,hqsy,"horiz quotient","#f97316","10");
  arrow(svgR,origx,origy,vqsx,vqsy,"#3b82f6");
  lbl(svgR,vqsx+5,vqsy,"vert quotient","#3b82f6","10");
  dot(svgR,origx,origy,4,"#6b7280");
  // Label: they agree (f=z² is analytic)
  const agree=Math.abs(hqr-vqr)+Math.abs(hqi-vqi)<0.3;
  lbl(svgR,6,H-8, agree?"Quotients agree — C-R holds":"Quotients differ — C-R fails", agree?"#059669":"#dc2626","10");

  const wrap=document.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.cssText="display:flex; gap:0.75rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:0.75rem 0;";
  wrap.appendChild(svgL); wrap.appendChild(svgR);

  const note=document.createElement("div");
  note.style.cssText="font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic; margin-top:0.3rem;";
  note.textContent="Static illustration for f(z) = z², z₀ = 0.7+0.5i, Δ = 0.4. Left: two approach directions toward z₀. Right: the two difference quotient vectors point to the same destination — confirming that f = z² is differentiable at z₀. The interactive below lets you explore other functions.";

  const outer=document.createElement("div");
  outer.appendChild(wrap); outer.appendChild(note);
  return outer;
}
```

Approach $z_0 = x_0+iy_0$ along two different directions and demand the limit is the same.

**Horizontal approach** ($z = x+iy_0$, $z-z_0 = \Delta x$):

Write $f(z) - f(z_0) = [u(x_0+\Delta x, y_0) - u(x_0, y_0)] + i[v(x_0+\Delta x, y_0) - v(x_0, y_0)]$. Dividing by the real number $\Delta x$ keeps real and imaginary parts separate:
$$\frac{f(z)-f(z_0)}{\Delta x} = \frac{[u(x_0+\Delta x,\,y_0)-u(x_0,y_0)]}{\Delta x} + i\frac{[v(x_0+\Delta x,\,y_0)-v(x_0,y_0)]}{\Delta x}$$

Taking $\Delta x \to 0$, each fraction is just a partial derivative:
$$f'(z_0) = u_x + iv_x$$

**Vertical approach** ($z = x_0+iy$, $z-z_0 = i\Delta y$):

Now the increment is purely imaginary, so we divide by $i\Delta y$. Dividing by $i$ is the same as multiplying by $-i$, which swaps real and imaginary parts. Carrying through:
$$\frac{f(z)-f(z_0)}{i\Delta y} = \frac{1}{i}\cdot\frac{[u(x_0,y_0+\Delta y)-u(x_0,y_0)]+i[v(x_0,y_0+\Delta y)-v(x_0,y_0)]}{\Delta y}$$

Using $1/i = -i$ and taking $\Delta y \to 0$:
$$f'(z_0) = v_y - iu_y$$

Equating real and imaginary parts of $u_x + iv_x = v_y - iu_y$:

$$\boxed{u_x = v_y \qquad u_y = -v_x}$$

These are the **Cauchy-Riemann (C-R) equations**. They are necessary for complex differentiability. If the partial derivatives are continuous in a neighbourhood of $z_0$, they are also sufficient.

*Quick check.* For $f(z) = z^2$ we found $u = x^2-y^2$, $v = 2xy$ earlier. Verify: $u_x = 2x = v_y$ and $u_y = -2y = -v_x = -2y$. Both equations hold everywhere — consistent with $z^2$ being entire. Exercise 1 walks through this systematically and uses the result to compute $f'(z)$.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  // C-R approach-direction demo
  // Left panel: z-plane with z₀ (draggable via sliders), two approach arrows
  // Right: "derivative plane" showing the two difference quotients as Δ→0
  const W = 320, H = 300, SCALE = 70;
  const CX = W/2, CY = H/2;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  const funcSel = Inputs.select(
    ["f(z) = z²", "f(z) = eᶻ", "f(z) = z̄", "f(z) = |z|²"],
    { value: "f(z) = z²", label: "Function" }
  );
  const z0xSlider = Inputs.range([-2, 2], { value: 0.7, step: 0.1, label: "Re(z₀)" });
  const z0ySlider = Inputs.range([-2, 2], { value: 0.5, step: 0.1, label: "Im(z₀)" });
  const deltaSlider = Inputs.range([0.02, 1.0], { value: 0.5, step: 0.02, label: "Δ (step size)" });

  function evalF(name, re, im) {
    switch (name) {
      case "f(z) = z²":   return [re*re - im*im, 2*re*im];
      case "f(z) = eᶻ": { const ex=Math.exp(re); return [ex*Math.cos(im), ex*Math.sin(im)]; }
      case "f(z) = z̄":   return [re, -im];
      case "f(z) = |z|²": return [re*re + im*im, 0];
      default:             return [re, im];
    }
  }

  function toScreen(re, im) { return [CX + re*SCALE, CY - im*SCALE]; }
  function fromScreen(px, py) { return [(px-CX)/SCALE, -(py-CY)/SCALE]; }

  function makePanel(w, h, title) {
    const svg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width", w); svg.setAttribute("height", h);
    svg.style.cssText = "background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";
    // Grid
    for (let i=-3; i<=3; i++) {
      const xl = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
      const [lx]=toScreen(i,0); const [,ly1]=toScreen(0,-3); const [,ly2]=toScreen(0,3);
      xl.setAttribute("x1",lx); xl.setAttribute("y1",ly1); xl.setAttribute("x2",lx); xl.setAttribute("y2",ly2);
      xl.setAttribute("stroke","#e5e7eb"); xl.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.5"); svg.appendChild(xl);
      const yl = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
      const [lx1]=toScreen(-3,0); const [lx2]=toScreen(3,0); const [,ly]=toScreen(0,i);
      yl.setAttribute("x1",lx1); yl.setAttribute("y1",ly); yl.setAttribute("x2",lx2); yl.setAttribute("y2",ly);
      yl.setAttribute("stroke","#e5e7eb"); yl.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.5"); svg.appendChild(yl);
    }
    // Axes
    const [ox,oy]=toScreen(0,0);
    function axLine(x1,y1,x2,y2) {
      const l=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
      l.setAttribute("x1",x1); l.setAttribute("y1",y1); l.setAttribute("x2",x2); l.setAttribute("y2",y2);
      l.setAttribute("stroke","#9ca3af"); l.setAttribute("stroke-width","1"); svg.appendChild(l);
    }
    const [ax1]=toScreen(-2.8,0); const [ax2]=toScreen(2.8,0);
    axLine(ax1,oy,ax2,oy);
    const [,ay1]=toScreen(0,-2.3); const [,ay2]=toScreen(0,2.3);
    axLine(ox,ay1,ox,ay2);
    // Panel label
    const tl = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
    tl.setAttribute("x","6"); tl.setAttribute("y","16");
    tl.setAttribute("fill","#6b7280"); tl.setAttribute("font-size","10");
    tl.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif"); tl.textContent = title;
    svg.appendChild(tl);
    return { svg, ox, oy };
  }

  function arrowHead(svg, x2, y2, dx, dy, color) {
    const len = Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    if (len < 0.001) return;
    const ux=dx/len, uy=dy/len;
    const size=7;
    const lx=x2-ux*size+uy*size*0.4, ly=y2-uy*size-ux*size*0.4;
    const rx=x2-ux*size-uy*size*0.4, ry=y2-uy*size+ux*size*0.4;
    const tri=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"polygon");
    tri.setAttribute("points",`${x2},${y2} ${lx},${ly} ${rx},${ry}`);
    tri.setAttribute("fill",color); svg.appendChild(tri);
  }

  function addArrow(svg, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, dash) {
    const l=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
    l.setAttribute("x1",x1); l.setAttribute("y1",y1); l.setAttribute("x2",x2); l.setAttribute("y2",y2);
    l.setAttribute("stroke",color); l.setAttribute("stroke-width","2");
    if (dash) l.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray",dash);
    svg.appendChild(l);
    arrowHead(svg, x2, y2, x2-x1, y2-y1, color);
  }

  function addDot(svg, cx, cy, r, fill, stroke) {
    const c=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"circle");
    c.setAttribute("cx",cx); c.setAttribute("cy",cy); c.setAttribute("r",r);
    c.setAttribute("fill",fill); c.setAttribute("stroke",stroke||"#fff"); c.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");
    svg.appendChild(c);
  }

  function addLabel(svg, x, y, txt, color, size) {
    const t=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
    t.setAttribute("x",x); t.setAttribute("y",y);
    t.setAttribute("fill",color); t.setAttribute("font-size",size||"11");
    t.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif"); t.textContent=txt;
    svg.appendChild(t);
  }

  function buildCRPanel(funcName, z0x, z0y, delta) {
    const { svg: svgL } = makePanel(W, H, "z-plane");

    // C-R background wash: pixel-test each cell
    const WASH_STEP = 12, H_EPS = 0.01;
    for (let px=0; px<W; px+=WASH_STEP) {
      for (let py=0; py<H; py+=WASH_STEP) {
        const [re,im] = fromScreen(px+WASH_STEP/2, py+WASH_STEP/2);
        const [u0,v0]=evalF(funcName,re,im);
        const [udx,vdx]=evalF(funcName,re+H_EPS,im);
        const [udy,vdy]=evalF(funcName,re,im+H_EPS);
        const ux=(udx-u0)/H_EPS, vx=(vdx-v0)/H_EPS;
        const uy=(udy-u0)/H_EPS, vy=(vdy-v0)/H_EPS;
        const err = Math.abs(ux-vy) + Math.abs(uy+vx);
        const ok = err < 0.05;
        const rect=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"rect");
        rect.setAttribute("x",px); rect.setAttribute("y",py);
        rect.setAttribute("width",WASH_STEP); rect.setAttribute("height",WASH_STEP);
        rect.setAttribute("fill", ok ? "#059669" : "#dc2626");
        rect.setAttribute("opacity","0.12");
        svgL.appendChild(rect);
      }
    }

    // z₀ point
    const [z0sx, z0sy] = toScreen(z0x, z0y);
    addDot(svgL, z0sx, z0sy, 7, "#f97316", "#fff");
    addLabel(svgL, z0sx+9, z0sy-6, "z₀", "#f97316", "12");

    // Horizontal approach arrow: z₀ + Δ → z₀
    const [hsx] = toScreen(z0x + delta, z0y);
    addArrow(svgL, hsx, z0sy, z0sx, z0sy, "#f97316", "");
    addLabel(svgL, hsx+4, z0sy-4, "→ z₀", "#f97316", "10");

    // Vertical approach arrow: z₀ + iΔ → z₀
    const [,vsy] = toScreen(z0x, z0y + delta);
    addArrow(svgL, z0sx, vsy, z0sx, z0sy, "#3b82f6", "");
    addLabel(svgL, z0sx+4, vsy-4, "↑ z₀", "#3b82f6", "10");

    // Panel labels
    addLabel(svgL, 6, H-8, "Green = C-R holds   Red = fails", "#6b7280", "9");

    // Right panel: derivative plane — two quotient vectors
    const { svg: svgR } = makePanel(W, H, "difference quotient");

    const f0 = evalF(funcName, z0x, z0y);
    const fHoriz = evalF(funcName, z0x + delta, z0y);
    const fVert  = evalF(funcName, z0x, z0y + delta);

    // Horizontal quotient: (f(z₀+Δ) − f(z₀)) / Δ   (real Δ)
    const hqr = (fHoriz[0]-f0[0])/delta, hqi = (fHoriz[1]-f0[1])/delta;
    // Vertical quotient: (f(z₀+iΔ) − f(z₀)) / (iΔ) = −i·(Δf)/Δ
    const vqr = (fVert[1]-f0[1])/delta, vqi = -(fVert[0]-f0[0])/delta;

    const [origx, origy] = toScreen(0,0);
    const [hqsx, hqsy] = toScreen(hqr, hqi);
    const [vqsx, vqsy] = toScreen(vqr, vqi);

    addArrow(svgR, origx, origy, hqsx, hqsy, "#f97316", "");
    addLabel(svgR, hqsx+6, hqsy, "horiz", "#f97316", "10");

    addArrow(svgR, origx, origy, vqsx, vqsy, "#3b82f6", "");
    addLabel(svgR, vqsx+6, vqsy, "vert", "#3b82f6", "10");

    addDot(svgR, origx, origy, 4, "#6b7280", "#fff");

    // Check agreement
    const agree = Math.abs(hqr-vqr) + Math.abs(hqi-vqi);
    const color = agree < 0.15 ? "#059669" : "#dc2626";
    const msg   = agree < 0.15 ? "Quotients agree — f differentiable here" : "Quotients differ — C-R fails here";
    addLabel(svgR, 6, H-20, msg, color, "10");
    addLabel(svgR, 6, H-8, `|error| = ${agree.toFixed(3)} (small Δ → more precise)`, "#9ca3af", "9");

    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.style.cssText = "display:flex; gap:0.75rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:0.5rem 0;";
    wrap.appendChild(svgL);
    wrap.appendChild(svgR);
    return wrap;
  }

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0;";

  const titleEl = document.createElement("div");
  titleEl.style.cssText = "font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem; font-family:sans-serif;";
  titleEl.textContent = "Cauchy-Riemann: approach-direction explorer";
  container.appendChild(titleEl);

  container.appendChild(funcSel);
  container.appendChild(z0xSlider);
  container.appendChild(z0ySlider);
  container.appendChild(deltaSlider);

  const vizDiv = document.createElement("div");
  container.appendChild(vizDiv);

  const noteEl = document.createElement("div");
  noteEl.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
  noteEl.textContent = "Left: z-plane with orange (horizontal) and blue (vertical) approach arrows toward z₀. Background green where C-R holds, red where it fails. Right: the two difference quotients as vectors — they must point to the same place for f to be differentiable at z₀. Reduce Δ to see the quotients converge (or not). For f = z̄ the entire left panel is red and the quotient vectors never align.";
  container.appendChild(noteEl);

  function update() {
    vizDiv.innerHTML = "";
    vizDiv.appendChild(buildCRPanel(funcSel.value, z0xSlider.value, z0ySlider.value, deltaSlider.value));
  }
  funcSel.addEventListener("input", update);
  z0xSlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  z0ySlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  deltaSlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  update();

  return container;
}
```


**Consequence.** For $f(z) = \bar{z}$: $u_x = 1$ but $v_y = -1$. The C-R equations fail everywhere, so $\bar{z}$ is nowhere differentiable — even though its real and imaginary parts are smooth real functions.

When the C-R equations hold, the derivative can be written in any of the equivalent forms:
$$f'(z) = u_x + iv_x = v_y - iu_y$$

---

## Analytic functions

$f$ is **analytic at $z_0$** if it is differentiable in some open disk centred at $z_0$. It is **analytic in a domain $D$** if differentiable at every point of $D$. A function analytic on all of $\mathbb{C}$ is called **entire**.

Being differentiable at an isolated point does not make a function analytic — analyticity requires differentiability in an open neighbourhood. Exercise 4 shows this with $f(z) = |z|^2$, which is differentiable only at the origin and analytic nowhere.

### Harmonic functions

If $f = u + iv$ is analytic, both $u$ and $v$ satisfy **Laplace's equation**:
$$\nabla^2 u = u_{xx} + u_{yy} = 0, \qquad \nabla^2 v = 0$$

*Proof.* From the C-R equations: $u_{xx} = (u_x)_x = (v_y)_x = v_{yx}$ and $u_{yy} = (u_y)_y = (-v_x)_y = -v_{xy}$. Since mixed partials are equal, $u_{xx} + u_{yy} = 0$.

A function satisfying Laplace's equation is **harmonic**. So: the real and imaginary parts of any analytic function are harmonic.

Conversely, given a harmonic $u$ on a **simply connected domain** — one with no holes, so that any closed loop inside it can be continuously shrunk to a point — there exists a **harmonic conjugate** $v$ (unique up to a constant) such that $f = u + iv$ is analytic. Finding $v$ from $u$ via the C-R equations is a standard technique.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  // Harmonic function landscape
  // Dual canvas: left = u(x,y) equipotential contours + optional Laplacian check
  //              right = v(x,y) streamlines (or combined orthogonality view)
  const W = 300, H = 280, SCALE = 55;
  const CX = W/2, CY = H/2;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  const funcSel  = Inputs.select(
    ["f = z²", "f = eᶻ", "f = sin z", "f = z³"],
    { value: "f = z²", label: "Analytic function" }
  );
  const modeToggle  = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Show Laplacian check (grey = harmonic, red = not)", value: false });
  const orthToggle  = Inputs.toggle({ label: "Show orthogonality overlay", value: false });
  const ptxSlider   = Inputs.range([-2, 2], { value: 0.8, step: 0.1, label: "Probe Re(z)" });
  const ptySlider   = Inputs.range([-2, 2], { value: 0.6, step: 0.1, label: "Probe Im(z)" });

  function evalF(name, re, im) {
    switch (name) {
      case "f = z²":  return [re*re - im*im, 2*re*im];
      case "f = eᶻ": { const ex=Math.exp(re); return [ex*Math.cos(im), ex*Math.sin(im)]; }
      case "f = sin z": return [Math.sin(re)*Math.cosh(im), Math.cos(re)*Math.sinh(im)];
      case "f = z³":  return [re*re*re - 3*re*im*im, 3*re*re*im - im*im*im];
      default:         return [re, im];
    }
  }

  function getU(name, re, im) { return evalF(name,re,im)[0]; }
  function getV(name, re, im) { return evalF(name,re,im)[1]; }

  // Draw a canvas panel: heatmap of scalar field + iso-contours
  function renderHeatmap(canvas, name, component, showLaplacian, showOrth) {
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    const img = ctx.createImageData(W, H);
    const d = img.data;
    const H_EPS = 0.05;

    // First pass: collect min/max of field
    let fmin = Infinity, fmax = -Infinity;
    for (let px=0; px<W; px+=2) {
      for (let py=0; py<H; py+=2) {
        const re=(px-CX)/SCALE, im=-(py-CY)/SCALE;
        const v = component === "u" ? getU(name,re,im) : getV(name,re,im);
        if (isFinite(v)) { if(v<fmin) fmin=v; if(v>fmax) fmax=v; }
      }
    }
    const frange = fmax - fmin || 1;

    for (let px=0; px<W; px++) {
      for (let py=0; py<H; py++) {
        const re=(px-CX)/SCALE, im=-(py-CY)/SCALE;
        const idx=(py*W+px)*4;

        if (showLaplacian) {
          // Numerical Laplacian check: ∇²u ≈ (u(+h)-2u+u(-h))/h² + same for y
          const u0   = getU(name,re,im);
          const upx  = getU(name,re+H_EPS,im);
          const umx  = getU(name,re-H_EPS,im);
          const upy  = getU(name,re,im+H_EPS);
          const umy  = getU(name,re,im-H_EPS);
          const lap  = (upx+umx+upy+umy-4*u0)/(H_EPS*H_EPS);
          const err  = Math.min(Math.abs(lap)/5, 1);
          // Near-zero → grey, large → red
          d[idx]   = Math.round(180 + err*75);
          d[idx+1] = Math.round(180 - err*150);
          d[idx+2] = Math.round(180 - err*150);
          d[idx+3] = 255;
        } else {
          const fv = component === "u" ? getU(name,re,im) : getV(name,re,im);
          if (!isFinite(fv)) { d[idx]=255; d[idx+1]=255; d[idx+2]=255; d[idx+3]=255; continue; }
          const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (fv-fmin)/frange));
          // Blue-white-orange diverging palette
          if (t < 0.5) {
            const s = t*2;
            d[idx]   = Math.round(59+s*(255-59));
            d[idx+1] = Math.round(130+s*(255-130));
            d[idx+2] = Math.round(246+s*(255-246));
          } else {
            const s = (t-0.5)*2;
            d[idx]   = Math.round(255);
            d[idx+1] = Math.round(255-s*(255-115));
            d[idx+2] = Math.round(255-s*(255-22));
          }
          d[idx+3] = 255;
        }
      }
    }
    ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);

    // Iso-contours via marching squares (simplified: draw line segments)
    function isoContour(field, level, color, alpha) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = 0.9;
      ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
      const step = 3;
      for (let px=0; px<W-step; px+=step) {
        for (let py=0; py<H-step; py+=step) {
          const re=(px-CX)/SCALE, im=-(py-CY)/SCALE;
          const v00=field(name,re,im),   v10=field(name,re+step/SCALE,im);
          const v01=field(name,re,im-step/SCALE), v11=field(name,re+step/SCALE,im-step/SCALE);
          const c0=(v00>level), c1=(v10>level), c2=(v11>level), c3=(v01>level);
          if (c0===c1 && c1===c2 && c2===c3) continue;
          function interp(v0,v1,x0,y0,x1,y1) {
            if (Math.abs(v1-v0)<1e-9) return [(x0+x1)/2,(y0+y1)/2];
            const t=(level-v0)/(v1-v0);
            return [x0+(x1-x0)*t, y0+(y1-y0)*t];
          }
          const pts=[];
          if (c0!==c1) pts.push(interp(v00,v10, px,py, px+step,py));
          if (c1!==c2) pts.push(interp(v10,v11, px+step,py, px+step,py+step));
          if (c3!==c2) pts.push(interp(v01,v11, px,py+step, px+step,py+step));
          if (c0!==c3) pts.push(interp(v00,v01, px,py, px,py+step));
          if (pts.length>=2) {
            ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]); ctx.lineTo(pts[1][0],pts[1][1]);
          }
        }
      }
      ctx.stroke(); ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    }

    // Draw several iso-levels
    const numLevels = 9;
    const isColor   = component === "u" ? "#1d4ed8" : "#6d28d9";
    for (let k=0; k<=numLevels; k++) {
      const lv = fmin + (k/numLevels)*frange;
      isoContour(component==="u"?getU:getV, lv, isColor, 0.7);
    }

    if (showOrth) {
      // Overlay v-contours on u-panel (or vice versa) to show orthogonality
      const crossField = component === "u" ? getV : getU;
      const [cfmin, cfmax] = (() => {
        let mn=Infinity,mx=-Infinity;
        for (let px=0; px<W; px+=4) for (let py=0; py<H; py+=4) {
          const re=(px-CX)/SCALE, im=-(py-CY)/SCALE;
          const v=crossField(name,re,im);
          if(isFinite(v)){if(v<mn)mn=v;if(v>mx)mx=v;}
        }
        return [mn,mx];
      })();
      for (let k=0; k<=numLevels; k++) {
        const lv=cfmin+(k/numLevels)*(cfmax-cfmin);
        isoContour(crossField, lv, component==="u"?"#8b5cf6":"#f97316", 0.55);
      }
    }

    // Axes
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)"; ctx.lineWidth=1; ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,CY); ctx.lineTo(W,CY); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(CX,0); ctx.lineTo(CX,H); ctx.stroke();

    // Axis labels
    ctx.fillStyle="#374151"; ctx.font="10px sans-serif";
    ctx.fillText("Re", W-22, CY-4); ctx.fillText("Im", CX+4, 12);

    // Panel title
    ctx.fillStyle="#1f2937"; ctx.font="bold 11px sans-serif";
    const panelTitle = showLaplacian ? "Laplacian ∇²u (grey = zero = harmonic)" :
                       (component==="u" ? "u(x,y) — equipotentials" : "v(x,y) — streamlines");
    ctx.fillText(panelTitle, 4, 12);
  }

  function renderProbeInfo(name, ptx, pty) {
    const [uv, vv] = evalF(name, ptx, pty);
    const eps = 0.02;
    const ux  = (getU(name,ptx+eps,pty)-getU(name,ptx-eps,pty))/(2*eps);
    const uy  = (getU(name,ptx,pty+eps)-getU(name,ptx,pty-eps))/(2*eps);
    const vx  = (getV(name,ptx+eps,pty)-getV(name,ptx-eps,pty))/(2*eps);
    const vy  = (getV(name,ptx,pty+eps)-getV(name,ptx,pty-eps))/(2*eps);
    const crErr = Math.abs(ux-vy)+Math.abs(uy+vx);
    const crOk  = crErr < 0.05;
    const lapU  = (getU(name,ptx+eps,pty)+getU(name,ptx-eps,pty)+getU(name,ptx,pty+eps)+getU(name,ptx,pty-eps)-4*uv)/(eps*eps);
    // Gradient dot product to check orthogonality
    const dot   = ux*vx + uy*vy;
    const info = document.createElement("div");
    info.style.cssText = "font-family:sans-serif; font-size:0.82em; color:#374151; margin-top:0.5rem; display:flex; gap:1.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap;";
    info.innerHTML = `
      <span>z₀ = ${ptx.toFixed(2)} + ${pty.toFixed(2)}i</span>
      <span>u = ${uv.toFixed(3)}</span>
      <span>v = ${vv.toFixed(3)}</span>
      <span style="color:${crOk?"#059669":"#dc2626"}">C-R: ${crOk?"✓ holds":"✗ fails"}</span>
      <span>∇²u ≈ ${lapU.toFixed(3)}</span>
      <span>∇u·∇v = ${dot.toFixed(3)} (≈0 means orthogonal)</span>
    `;
    return info;
  }

  function renderProbeOverlay(canvas, name, ptx, pty, component) {
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    const [psx, psy] = [CX + ptx*SCALE, CY - pty*SCALE];
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f97316"; ctx.strokeStyle="#fff"; ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(psx,psy,5,0,2*Math.PI); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    // Gradient arrow
    const eps = 0.06;
    const gx = component==="u" ? (getU(name,ptx+eps,pty)-getU(name,ptx-eps,pty))/(2*eps)
                                : (getV(name,ptx+eps,pty)-getV(name,ptx-eps,pty))/(2*eps);
    const gy = component==="u" ? (getU(name,ptx,pty+eps)-getU(name,ptx,pty-eps))/(2*eps)
                                : (getV(name,ptx,pty+eps)-getV(name,ptx,pty-eps))/(2*eps);
    const gLen = Math.sqrt(gx*gx+gy*gy)||1;
    const scale = 18;
    const ex = psx + (gx/gLen)*scale, ey = psy - (gy/gLen)*scale;
    ctx.strokeStyle="#f97316"; ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(psx,psy); ctx.lineTo(ex,ey); ctx.stroke();
  }

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0;";

  const titleEl = document.createElement("div");
  titleEl.style.cssText = "font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem; font-family:sans-serif;";
  titleEl.textContent = "Harmonic function landscape: equipotentials and streamlines";
  container.appendChild(titleEl);

  container.appendChild(funcSel);
  container.appendChild(modeToggle);
  container.appendChild(orthToggle);
  container.appendChild(ptxSlider);
  container.appendChild(ptySlider);

  const canvasRow = document.createElement("div");
  canvasRow.style.cssText = "display:flex; gap:0.75rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:0.5rem 0;";

  const cL = document.createElement("canvas"); cL.width=W; cL.height=H;
  cL.style.cssText = "border-radius:4px; display:block;";
  const cR = document.createElement("canvas"); cR.width=W; cR.height=H;
  cR.style.cssText = "border-radius:4px; display:block;";

  canvasRow.appendChild(cL); canvasRow.appendChild(cR);
  container.appendChild(canvasRow);

  const probeDiv = document.createElement("div");
  container.appendChild(probeDiv);

  const noteEl = document.createElement("div");
  noteEl.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.4rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
  noteEl.textContent = "Blue curves: equipotential lines (u = const). Purple curves: streamlines (v = const). Toggle orthogonality to see them overlaid — they meet at right angles everywhere the function is analytic. Toggle Laplacian check: the left panel turns uniformly grey confirming ∇²u = 0 throughout. Orange dot is a probe point; the orange arrow shows the gradient direction.";
  container.appendChild(noteEl);

  function update() {
    const fn = funcSel.value;
    const lapl = modeToggle.value;
    const orth = orthToggle.value;
    const ptx = ptxSlider.value, pty = ptySlider.value;

    renderHeatmap(cL, fn, "u", lapl, orth);
    renderHeatmap(cR, fn, "v", false, orth);
    renderProbeOverlay(cL, fn, ptx, pty, "u");
    renderProbeOverlay(cR, fn, ptx, pty, "v");

    probeDiv.innerHTML = "";
    probeDiv.appendChild(renderProbeInfo(fn, ptx, pty));
  }

  funcSel.addEventListener("input", update);
  modeToggle.addEventListener("input", update);
  orthToggle.addEventListener("input", update);
  ptxSlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  ptySlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  update();

  return container;
}
```

---

## Elementary analytic functions

### Exponential

$$e^z = e^x(\cos y + i\sin y), \qquad \frac{d}{dz}e^z = e^z$$

Entire. Periodic with period $2\pi i$: $e^{z+2\pi i} = e^z$.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  // Complex exponential periodicity
  // Left: z-plane with 2π-wide horizontal strips coloured by period band
  // A constrained point z moves along Re(z) = fixed with Im varying
  // Right: w-plane showing e^z tracing a circle |w| = e^{Re(z)}
  // Fading trail shows the orbit; counter shows full laps

  const W = 300, H = 280, SCALE = 55, CX = W/2, CY = H/2;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  const reSlider = Inputs.range([-1.5, 1.5], { value: 1.0, step: 0.1, label: "Re(z) — controls |e^z|" });
  const tSlider  = Inputs.range([0, 4*Math.PI], { value: 0, step: 0.05, label: "Im(z) = t" });

  const STRIP_COLORS = ["#dbeafe","#fef3c7","#d1fae5","#fce7f3","#ede9fe"];

  function toScreen(re, im) { return [CX + re*SCALE, CY - im*SCALE]; }

  function buildViz(reZ, tVal) {
    // Left SVG — z-plane
    const svgL = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"svg");
    svgL.setAttribute("width",W); svgL.setAttribute("height",H);
    svgL.style.cssText = "background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";

    // Period strips: horizontal bands of height 2π, coloured cyclically
    const stripH = 2*Math.PI * SCALE; // pixels per period
    const numStrips = Math.ceil(H / stripH) + 2;
    const stripOffset = CY; // y=0 maps to CY
    for (let k=-numStrips; k<=numStrips; k++) {
      const yTop = stripOffset - (k+1)*stripH;
      const rect = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"rect");
      rect.setAttribute("x","0"); rect.setAttribute("y", yTop.toFixed(1));
      rect.setAttribute("width", W); rect.setAttribute("height", stripH.toFixed(1));
      rect.setAttribute("fill", STRIP_COLORS[((k%5)+5)%5]);
      rect.setAttribute("opacity","0.55");
      svgL.appendChild(rect);
      // Strip label
      const yMid = yTop + stripH/2;
      if (yMid > 0 && yMid < H) {
        const lbl = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
        lbl.setAttribute("x","4"); lbl.setAttribute("y", (yMid+4).toFixed(1));
        lbl.setAttribute("fill","#6b7280"); lbl.setAttribute("font-size","9");
        lbl.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");
        lbl.textContent = `Im ∈ [${(k*2).toFixed(0)}π, ${(k*2+2).toFixed(0)}π)`;
        svgL.appendChild(lbl);
      }
    }

    // Grid lines (x only for clarity)
    for (let i=-3; i<=3; i++) {
      const xl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
      const [lx]=toScreen(i,0); const [,ly1]=toScreen(0,-3); const [,ly2]=toScreen(0,3);
      xl.setAttribute("x1",lx); xl.setAttribute("y1",ly1); xl.setAttribute("x2",lx); xl.setAttribute("y2",ly2);
      xl.setAttribute("stroke","rgba(0,0,0,0.08)"); xl.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.5");
      svgL.appendChild(xl);
    }

    // Axes
    const [ox,oy]=toScreen(0,0);
    function axLine(svg,x1,y1,x2,y2){ const l=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line"); l.setAttribute("x1",x1);l.setAttribute("y1",y1);l.setAttribute("x2",x2);l.setAttribute("y2",y2); l.setAttribute("stroke","#9ca3af");l.setAttribute("stroke-width","1");svg.appendChild(l); }
    const [ax1]=toScreen(-2.8,0); const [ax2]=toScreen(2.8,0);
    axLine(svgL,ax1,oy,ax2,oy);
    const [,ay1]=toScreen(0,-2.3); const [,ay2]=toScreen(0,2.3);
    axLine(svgL,ox,ay1,ox,ay2);

    // Vertical line at Re = reZ (the constrained path)
    const [reLineX]=toScreen(reZ,0);
    const pathLine=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
    pathLine.setAttribute("x1",reLineX); pathLine.setAttribute("y1","0");
    pathLine.setAttribute("x2",reLineX); pathLine.setAttribute("y2",H);
    pathLine.setAttribute("stroke","#f97316"); pathLine.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");
    pathLine.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray","5,3"); svgL.appendChild(pathLine);

    // Current z point
    const [zsx,zsy]=toScreen(reZ,tVal);
    const zDot=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"circle");
    zDot.setAttribute("cx",zsx); zDot.setAttribute("cy",zsy); zDot.setAttribute("r","6");
    zDot.setAttribute("fill","#f97316"); zDot.setAttribute("stroke","#fff"); zDot.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");
    svgL.appendChild(zDot);

    // Label
    const zLbl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
    zLbl.setAttribute("x",zsx+8); zLbl.setAttribute("y",zsy-4);
    zLbl.setAttribute("fill","#f97316"); zLbl.setAttribute("font-size","11");
    zLbl.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif"); zLbl.textContent=`z`;
    svgL.appendChild(zLbl);

    // Panel label
    const pl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text"); pl.setAttribute("x","6"); pl.setAttribute("y","14");
    pl.setAttribute("fill","#1f2937"); pl.setAttribute("font-size","11"); pl.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");
    pl.setAttribute("font-weight","bold"); pl.textContent="z-plane (coloured by 2π strips)";
    svgL.appendChild(pl);

    // Right SVG — w-plane
    const svgR = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"svg");
    svgR.setAttribute("width",W); svgR.setAttribute("height",H);
    svgR.style.cssText = "background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";

    const eRe = Math.exp(reZ); // radius of orbit = e^{Re z}
    const wCX = W/2, wCY = H/2;
    const wSCALE = Math.min(100/eRe, 70); // auto-scale so circle fits

    function toWScreen(re,im){ return [wCX+re*wSCALE, wCY-im*wSCALE]; }
    function axLineW(x1,y1,x2,y2){ const l=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line"); l.setAttribute("x1",x1);l.setAttribute("y1",y1);l.setAttribute("x2",x2);l.setAttribute("y2",y2); l.setAttribute("stroke","#9ca3af");l.setAttribute("stroke-width","1");svgR.appendChild(l); }
    axLineW(0,wCY,W,wCY); axLineW(wCX,0,wCX,H);

    // Draw circle |w| = e^{Re z}
    const circ=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"circle");
    circ.setAttribute("cx",wCX); circ.setAttribute("cy",wCY);
    circ.setAttribute("r",(eRe*wSCALE).toFixed(1));
    circ.setAttribute("fill","none"); circ.setAttribute("stroke","#d1d5db"); circ.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");
    svgR.appendChild(circ);

    // Trail: last 2π of orbit
    const TRAIL_STEPS = 80;
    const trailPath = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"path");
    let pathD="";
    for (let k=TRAIL_STEPS; k>=0; k--) {
      const pastT = tVal - (k/TRAIL_STEPS)*(2*Math.PI);
      const wr = eRe*Math.cos(pastT), wi = eRe*Math.sin(pastT);
      const [wx,wy]=toWScreen(wr,wi);
      pathD += (k===TRAIL_STEPS ? `M ${wx} ${wy}` : ` L ${wx} ${wy}`);
    }
    trailPath.setAttribute("d",pathD); trailPath.setAttribute("fill","none");
    trailPath.setAttribute("stroke","#3b82f6"); trailPath.setAttribute("stroke-width","2");
    trailPath.setAttribute("opacity","0.6"); svgR.appendChild(trailPath);

    // Current w point
    const wr=eRe*Math.cos(tVal), wi=eRe*Math.sin(tVal);
    const [wsx,wsy]=toWScreen(wr,wi);
    const wDot=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"circle");
    wDot.setAttribute("cx",wsx); wDot.setAttribute("cy",wsy); wDot.setAttribute("r","6");
    wDot.setAttribute("fill","#3b82f6"); wDot.setAttribute("stroke","#fff"); wDot.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");
    svgR.appendChild(wDot);

    // Radius annotation
    const rLine=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
    rLine.setAttribute("x1",wCX); rLine.setAttribute("y1",wCY);
    rLine.setAttribute("x2",wsx); rLine.setAttribute("y2",wsy);
    rLine.setAttribute("stroke","#6b7280"); rLine.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.8");
    rLine.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray","3,2"); svgR.appendChild(rLine);

    const rLbl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
    const midRx=wCX+(wsx-wCX)*0.5, midRy=wCY+(wsy-wCY)*0.5;
    rLbl.setAttribute("x",midRx+4); rLbl.setAttribute("y",midRy);
    rLbl.setAttribute("fill","#6b7280"); rLbl.setAttribute("font-size","10");
    rLbl.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");
    rLbl.textContent=`e^${reZ.toFixed(1)} ≈ ${eRe.toFixed(2)}`;
    svgR.appendChild(rLbl);

    // Orbit count
    const laps = Math.floor(tVal / (2*Math.PI));
    const lapBox=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"rect");
    lapBox.setAttribute("x",W-90); lapBox.setAttribute("y","5");
    lapBox.setAttribute("width","85"); lapBox.setAttribute("height","36");
    lapBox.setAttribute("fill","#1e40af"); lapBox.setAttribute("rx","5"); svgR.appendChild(lapBox);
    const lapTxt=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
    lapTxt.setAttribute("x",W-47); lapTxt.setAttribute("y","20");
    lapTxt.setAttribute("fill","white"); lapTxt.setAttribute("font-size","9");
    lapTxt.setAttribute("text-anchor","middle"); lapTxt.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");
    lapTxt.textContent="full orbits"; svgR.appendChild(lapTxt);
    const lapNum=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
    lapNum.setAttribute("x",W-47); lapNum.setAttribute("y","36");
    lapNum.setAttribute("fill","white"); lapNum.setAttribute("font-size","16");
    lapNum.setAttribute("text-anchor","middle"); lapNum.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");
    lapNum.setAttribute("font-weight","bold"); lapNum.textContent=laps.toString(); svgR.appendChild(lapNum);

    // Panel label
    const pr=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text"); pr.setAttribute("x","6"); pr.setAttribute("y","14");
    pr.setAttribute("fill","#1f2937"); pr.setAttribute("font-size","11"); pr.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");
    pr.setAttribute("font-weight","bold"); pr.textContent="w-plane: image e^z";
    svgR.appendChild(pr);

    const wrap=document.createElement("div");
    wrap.style.cssText="display:flex; gap:0.75rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:0.5rem 0;";
    wrap.appendChild(svgL); wrap.appendChild(svgR);
    return wrap;
  }

  const container=document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText="border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0;";

  const titleEl=document.createElement("div");
  titleEl.style.cssText="font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem; font-family:sans-serif;";
  titleEl.textContent="Complex exponential: periodicity in 2π strips";
  container.appendChild(titleEl);
  container.appendChild(reSlider);
  container.appendChild(tSlider);

  const vizDiv=document.createElement("div"); container.appendChild(vizDiv);

  const infoDiv=document.createElement("div");
  infoDiv.style.cssText="font-size:0.82em; color:#374151; font-family:sans-serif; margin-top:0.3rem;";
  container.appendChild(infoDiv);

  const noteEl=document.createElement("div");
  noteEl.style.cssText="margin-top:0.4rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
  noteEl.textContent="Left: z-plane with horizontal strips of height 2π — each strip maps to the same circle in the right panel. Drag Im(z) slider through 4π to see two full orbits. The orbit counter tracks how many times the point has gone round. Re(z) controls the radius of the orbit: |e^z| = e^{Re(z)}.";
  container.appendChild(noteEl);

  function update() {
    const reZ=reSlider.value, tVal=tSlider.value;
    vizDiv.innerHTML=""; vizDiv.appendChild(buildViz(reZ,tVal));
    const wr=Math.exp(reZ)*Math.cos(tVal), wi=Math.exp(reZ)*Math.sin(tVal);
    infoDiv.textContent=`z = ${reZ.toFixed(2)} + ${tVal.toFixed(2)}i   →   e^z = ${wr.toFixed(3)} + ${wi.toFixed(3)}i   |e^z| = ${Math.exp(reZ).toFixed(3)}`;
  }

  reSlider.addEventListener("input",update);
  tSlider.addEventListener("input",update);
  update();

  return container;
}
```

### Trigonometric

$$\cos z = \frac{e^{iz}+e^{-iz}}{2}, \qquad \sin z = \frac{e^{iz}-e^{-iz}}{2i}$$

Both entire. The identities $\cos^2 z + \sin^2 z = 1$ and all standard trig identities hold. For purely imaginary argument: $\cos(iy) = \cosh y$, $\sin(iy) = i\sinh y$ — the complex trig and hyperbolic functions are closely related.

### Logarithm

$$\log z = \ln|z| + i\arg z = \ln r + i\theta$$

**Multivalued**: $\arg z$ is defined only up to multiples of $2\pi$. The **principal value** $\text{Log}\,z = \ln|z| + i\,\text{Arg}\,z$ uses $\text{Arg}\,z \in (-\pi, \pi]$ and is analytic everywhere except on the **branch cut** along the negative real axis — the line where $\text{Arg}\,z$ jumps discontinuously by $2\pi$ as you cross it. Without the cut, $\text{Log}\,z$ cannot be made single-valued and continuous.

<!-- VIZ OPPORTUNITY 4: The argument, winding number, and branch cut. A closed path in the complex plane; animated point traces it; live arg(z) plot; winding counter; branch cut toggle. Series thread: winding number first appearance. -->

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const W = 400, H = 360, CX = 180, CY = 180, SCALE = 65;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  // Preset path configs: array of [re, im] control points defining a closed loop
  const paths = {
    "Loop around origin (winding = +1)": [
      [1.5, 0], [1.2, 1.2], [0, 1.8], [-1.2, 1.2], [-1.5, 0],
      [-1.2, -1.2], [0, -1.8], [1.2, -1.2]
    ],
    "Loop missing origin (winding = 0)": [
      [1.0, 0.8], [1.8, 0.4], [2.0, 1.2], [1.4, 1.8], [0.6, 1.4]
    ],
    "Double loop (winding = +2)": [
      [1.8, 0], [1.4, 1.0], [0, 1.8], [-1.4, 1.0], [-1.8, 0],
      [-1.4, -1.0], [0, -1.8], [1.4, -1.0],
      [1.2, 0.3], [0.5, 0.8], [-0.5, 0.5], [-0.8, 0], [-0.5, -0.5],
      [0.5, -0.8], [1.2, -0.3]
    ]
  };

  const pathSelector = Inputs.select(Object.keys(paths), {
    value: Object.keys(paths)[0],
    label: "Path"
  });
  const branchToggle = Inputs.toggle({label: "Show branch cut", value: false});
  const tSlider = Inputs.range([0, 1], {value: 0, step: 0.01, label: "Progress t"});

  function catmullRomPoint(pts, t) {
    const n = pts.length;
    const totalT = n;
    const tScaled = t * n;
    const i = Math.floor(tScaled) % n;
    const localT = tScaled - Math.floor(tScaled);

    const p0 = pts[(i - 1 + n) % n];
    const p1 = pts[i];
    const p2 = pts[(i + 1) % n];
    const p3 = pts[(i + 2) % n];

    const t2 = localT*localT, t3 = localT*t2;
    const re = 0.5*((2*p1[0]) + (-p0[0]+p2[0])*localT + (2*p0[0]-5*p1[0]+4*p2[0]-p3[0])*t2 + (-p0[0]+3*p1[0]-3*p2[0]+p3[0])*t3);
    const im = 0.5*((2*p1[1]) + (-p0[1]+p2[1])*localT + (2*p0[1]-5*p1[1]+4*p2[1]-p3[1])*t2 + (-p0[1]+3*p1[1]-3*p2[1]+p3[1])*t3);
    return [re, im];
  }

  function computeWindingAndArgTrace(pts, numSteps) {
    let totalDeltaArg = 0;
    let prevArg = null;
    const trace = [];

    for (let step = 0; step <= numSteps; step++) {
      const t = step / numSteps;
      const [re, im] = catmullRomPoint(pts, t);
      const arg = Math.atan2(im, re);

      if (prevArg !== null) {
        let dArg = arg - prevArg;
        while (dArg > Math.PI) dArg -= 2*Math.PI;
        while (dArg < -Math.PI) dArg += 2*Math.PI;
        totalDeltaArg += dArg;
      }
      prevArg = arg;
      trace.push([t, totalDeltaArg]);
    }
    return trace;
  }

  function toScreen(re, im) {
    return [CX + re*SCALE, CY - im*SCALE];
  }

  function render(pathName, showBranch, tVal) {
    const pts = paths[pathName];
    const STEPS = 300;
    const argTrace = computeWindingAndArgTrace(pts, STEPS);
    const windingAtEnd = argTrace[STEPS][1] / (2*Math.PI);
    const windingRounded = Math.round(windingAtEnd);

    // SVG
    const svg = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width", W); svg.setAttribute("height", H);
    svg.style.cssText = "background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";

    // Grid
    const gridG = document.createElementNS(svgNS, "g");
    gridG.setAttribute("stroke", "#e5e7eb"); gridG.setAttribute("stroke-width", "0.5");
    for (let i=-3; i<=3; i++) {
      const xl = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
      const [lx] = toScreen(i,0); const [,ly1] = toScreen(0,-3); const [,ly2] = toScreen(0,3);
      xl.setAttribute("x1",lx); xl.setAttribute("y1",ly1); xl.setAttribute("x2",lx); xl.setAttribute("y2",ly2);
      gridG.appendChild(xl);
      const yl = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
      const [lx1] = toScreen(-3,0); const [lx2] = toScreen(3,0); const [,ly] = toScreen(0,i);
      yl.setAttribute("x1",lx1); yl.setAttribute("y1",ly); yl.setAttribute("x2",lx2); yl.setAttribute("y2",ly);
      gridG.appendChild(yl);
    }
    svg.appendChild(gridG);

    // Axes
    const [ox, oy] = toScreen(0,0);
    const axG = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"g"); axG.setAttribute("stroke","#9ca3af"); axG.setAttribute("stroke-width","1");
    const xa = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
    const [ax1] = toScreen(-3.2,0); const [ax2] = toScreen(3.2,0);
    xa.setAttribute("x1",ax1); xa.setAttribute("y1",oy); xa.setAttribute("x2",ax2); xa.setAttribute("y2",oy);
    const ya = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
    const [,ay1] = toScreen(0,-2.6); const [,ay2] = toScreen(0,2.6);
    ya.setAttribute("x1",ox); ya.setAttribute("y1",ay1); ya.setAttribute("x2",ox); ya.setAttribute("y2",ay2);
    axG.appendChild(xa); axG.appendChild(ya);
    svg.appendChild(axG);

    // Branch cut: negative real axis
    if (showBranch) {
      const bc = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
      const [bx1] = toScreen(-3.2,0); const [bx2] = toScreen(0,0);
      bc.setAttribute("x1",bx1); bc.setAttribute("y1",oy); bc.setAttribute("x2",bx2); bc.setAttribute("y2",oy);
      bc.setAttribute("stroke","#ef4444"); bc.setAttribute("stroke-width","2.5");
      bc.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray","6,3");
      svg.appendChild(bc);
      const bcLabel = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
      const [blx] = toScreen(-2,0);
      bcLabel.setAttribute("x",blx); bcLabel.setAttribute("y",oy-6);
      bcLabel.setAttribute("fill","#ef4444"); bcLabel.setAttribute("font-size","10");
      bcLabel.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif"); bcLabel.textContent="branch cut";
      svg.appendChild(bcLabel);
    }

    // Full path
    let pathD = "";
    for (let s=0; s<=STEPS; s++) {
      const t = s/STEPS;
      const [re,im] = catmullRomPoint(pts, t);
      const [px,py] = toScreen(re,im);
      pathD += (s===0 ? `M ${px} ${py}` : ` L ${px} ${py}`);
    }
    pathD += " Z";
    const pathEl = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"path");
    pathEl.setAttribute("d",pathD); pathEl.setAttribute("fill","none");
    pathEl.setAttribute("stroke","#f97316"); pathEl.setAttribute("stroke-width","2");
    svg.appendChild(pathEl);

    // Animated point
    const currentStep = Math.round(tVal * STEPS);
    const [cre,cim] = catmullRomPoint(pts, tVal);
    const [cpx,cpy] = toScreen(cre,cim);
    const pt = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"circle");
    pt.setAttribute("cx",cpx); pt.setAttribute("cy",cpy); pt.setAttribute("r","6");
    pt.setAttribute("fill","#3b82f6"); pt.setAttribute("stroke","#fff"); pt.setAttribute("stroke-width","2");
    svg.appendChild(pt);

    // Origin mark
    const origPt = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"circle");
    origPt.setAttribute("cx",ox); origPt.setAttribute("cy",oy); origPt.setAttribute("r","4");
    origPt.setAttribute("fill","#1f2937"); origPt.setAttribute("stroke","#fff"); origPt.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");
    svg.appendChild(origPt);
    const origLabel = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
    origLabel.setAttribute("x",ox+5); origLabel.setAttribute("y",oy-6);
    origLabel.setAttribute("fill","#1f2937"); origLabel.setAttribute("font-size","10");
    origLabel.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif"); origLabel.textContent="O";
    svg.appendChild(origLabel);

    // Winding number display
    const windBox = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"rect");
    windBox.setAttribute("x",W-95); windBox.setAttribute("y",5);
    windBox.setAttribute("width",88); windBox.setAttribute("height",44);
    windBox.setAttribute("fill","#1e40af"); windBox.setAttribute("rx","5");
    svg.appendChild(windBox);
    const windLabel = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
    windLabel.setAttribute("x",W-51); windLabel.setAttribute("y",22);
    windLabel.setAttribute("fill","white"); windLabel.setAttribute("font-size","11");
    windLabel.setAttribute("text-anchor","middle"); windLabel.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");
    windLabel.textContent = "winding #";
    svg.appendChild(windLabel);
    const windNum = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
    windNum.setAttribute("x",W-51); windNum.setAttribute("y",41);
    windNum.setAttribute("fill","white"); windNum.setAttribute("font-size","18");
    windNum.setAttribute("text-anchor","middle"); windNum.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");
    windNum.setAttribute("font-weight","bold");
    windNum.textContent = (tVal < 0.99) ? "..." : windingRounded.toString();
    svg.appendChild(windNum);

    // Arg trace mini-chart
    const chartX = 0, chartY = H - 70, chartW = W, chartH = 65;
    const chartBg = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"rect");
    chartBg.setAttribute("x",chartX); chartBg.setAttribute("y",chartY);
    chartBg.setAttribute("width",chartW); chartBg.setAttribute("height",chartH);
    chartBg.setAttribute("fill","rgba(241,245,249,0.9)");
    svg.appendChild(chartBg);

    const maxArgAbs = Math.max(2*Math.PI*1.5, Math.abs(argTrace[STEPS][1]) * 1.2);
    function argToChart(t, argVal) {
      const cx = chartX + t * chartW;
      const cy = chartY + chartH/2 - (argVal / maxArgAbs) * (chartH/2 - 6);
      return [cx, cy];
    }

    // Zero line
    const [zx1, zy1] = argToChart(0, 0); const [zx2] = argToChart(1, 0);
    const zeroLine = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
    zeroLine.setAttribute("x1",zx1); zeroLine.setAttribute("y1",zy1);
    zeroLine.setAttribute("x2",zx2); zeroLine.setAttribute("y2",zy1);
    zeroLine.setAttribute("stroke","#9ca3af"); zeroLine.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.8");
    zeroLine.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray","3,3");
    svg.appendChild(zeroLine);

    // Arg trace line up to current t
    let traceD = "";
    for (let s=0; s<=currentStep && s < argTrace.length; s++) {
      const [tc, argVal] = argTrace[s];
      const [cx, cy] = argToChart(tc, argVal);
      traceD += (s===0 ? `M ${cx} ${cy}` : ` L ${cx} ${cy}`);
    }
    const traceEl = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"path");
    traceEl.setAttribute("d",traceD); traceEl.setAttribute("fill","none");
    traceEl.setAttribute("stroke","#8b5cf6"); traceEl.setAttribute("stroke-width","2");
    svg.appendChild(traceEl);

    const chartLabel = document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
    chartLabel.setAttribute("x",chartX+4); chartLabel.setAttribute("y",chartY+12);
    chartLabel.setAttribute("fill","#6b7280"); chartLabel.setAttribute("font-size","9");
    chartLabel.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif"); chartLabel.textContent="arg(z(t))";
    svg.appendChild(chartLabel);

    return svg;
  }

  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0;";

  const title = document.createElement("div");
  title.style.cssText = "font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem; font-family:sans-serif;";
  title.textContent = "Winding number and the branch cut";
  container.appendChild(title);

  container.appendChild(pathSelector);
  container.appendChild(branchToggle);
  container.appendChild(tSlider);

  const vizDiv = document.createElement("div");
  container.appendChild(vizDiv);

  const note = document.createElement("div");
  note.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
  note.textContent = "Move the slider to animate the point around the path. The purple trace shows arg(z) accumulating. When the path closes: if it enclosed the origin, arg increased by 2π (winding number = 1). If not, arg returned to its start. The red dashed line is the branch cut — where Arg z jumps by 2π.";
  container.appendChild(note);

  function update() {
    vizDiv.innerHTML = "";
    vizDiv.appendChild(render(pathSelector.value, branchToggle.value, tSlider.value));
  }
  pathSelector.addEventListener("input", update);
  branchToggle.addEventListener("input", update);
  tSlider.addEventListener("input", update);
  update();

  return container;
}
```

### Complex powers

$$z^\alpha = e^{\alpha \log z}$$

Multivalued in general. Integer powers are single-valued and entire; non-integer powers require a branch cut.
