## Conformal mappings: preview

At any point $z_0$ where $f$ is analytic and $f'(z_0) \neq 0$, the map $f$ is **conformal** (Chapter 4): it preserves the angle between any two curves crossing at $z_0$ (in magnitude and orientation). The scale factor is $|f'(z_0)|$ and the rotation angle is $\arg f'(z_0)$.

Conformal mappings transform solutions of Laplace's equation from one domain into solutions in another. That is how potential-flow problems, electrostatic field calculations, and heat-conduction problems in irregular geometries are reduced to solvable ones. Chapter 4 develops this fully.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  // Conformal angle-preservation test
  // Left: z-plane with z₀ (slider-controlled) and two arm lines at angles α₁, α₂
  // Right: w-plane showing images of those arms; live angle readout
  // Critical-point detection: when f'(z₀)=0, the map is not conformal there
  // f=z̄ demo reveals reflection (angle reversed)

  const W = 310, H = 290, SCALE = 65, CX = W/2, CY = H/2;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  const funcSel = Inputs.select(
    ["f(z) = z²", "f(z) = eᶻ", "f(z) = sin z", "f(z) = 1/z", "f(z) = z̄"],
    { value: "f(z) = z²", label: "Function" }
  );
  const z0xSl = Inputs.range([-1.8, 1.8], { value: 0.8, step: 0.1, label: "Re(z₀)" });
  const z0ySl = Inputs.range([-1.8, 1.8], { value: 0.6, step: 0.1, label: "Im(z₀)" });
  const arm1Sl = Inputs.range([0, 2*Math.PI], { value: 0.3, step: 0.1, label: "Arm 1 angle α₁" });
  const arm2Sl = Inputs.range([0, 2*Math.PI], { value: 1.1, step: 0.1, label: "Arm 2 angle α₂" });

  function evalF(name, re, im) {
    switch (name) {
      case "f(z) = z²":   return [re*re-im*im, 2*re*im];
      case "f(z) = eᶻ": { const ex=Math.exp(re); return [ex*Math.cos(im), ex*Math.sin(im)]; }
      case "f(z) = sin z": return [Math.sin(re)*Math.cosh(im), Math.cos(re)*Math.sinh(im)];
      case "f(z) = 1/z": { const d=re*re+im*im; if(d<1e-9)return[NaN,NaN]; return[re/d,-im/d]; }
      case "f(z) = z̄":   return [re, -im];
      default:             return [re, im];
    }
  }

  // Numerical derivative f'(z₀)
  function evalFPrime(name, re, im) {
    const eps=0.001;
    const [fr,fi]=evalF(name,re,im);
    const [hr,hi]=evalF(name,re+eps,im);
    return [(hr-fr)/eps, (hi-fi)/eps];
  }

  function toScreen(re,im,cx,cy,sc){ return [cx+re*sc, cy-im*sc]; }
  function fromScreen(px,py,cx,cy,sc){ return [(px-cx)/sc, -(py-cy)/sc]; }

  function addLine(svg,x1,y1,x2,y2,color,w,dash){
    const l=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
    l.setAttribute("x1",x1);l.setAttribute("y1",y1);l.setAttribute("x2",x2);l.setAttribute("y2",y2);
    l.setAttribute("stroke",color);l.setAttribute("stroke-width",w||"1.5");
    if(dash)l.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray",dash);
    svg.appendChild(l);
  }
  function addCircle(svg,cx,cy,r,fill,stroke){
    const c=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"circle");
    c.setAttribute("cx",cx);c.setAttribute("cy",cy);c.setAttribute("r",r);
    c.setAttribute("fill",fill);c.setAttribute("stroke",stroke||"#fff");c.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");
    svg.appendChild(c);
  }
  function addText(svg,x,y,txt,color,size){
    const t=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
    t.setAttribute("x",x);t.setAttribute("y",y);t.setAttribute("fill",color);
    t.setAttribute("font-size",size||"11");t.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");
    t.textContent=txt; svg.appendChild(t);
  }
  function makeSVG(label){
    const svg=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"svg");
    svg.setAttribute("width",W); svg.setAttribute("height",H);
    svg.style.cssText="background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";
    // Grid
    for(let i=-3;i<=3;i++){
      const xl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
      const [lx]=toScreen(i,0,CX,CY,SCALE); xl.setAttribute("x1",lx);xl.setAttribute("y1","0");xl.setAttribute("x2",lx);xl.setAttribute("y2",H);
      xl.setAttribute("stroke","#e5e7eb");xl.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.5");svg.appendChild(xl);
      const yl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
      const [,ly]=toScreen(0,i,CX,CY,SCALE); yl.setAttribute("x1","0");yl.setAttribute("y1",ly);yl.setAttribute("x2",W);yl.setAttribute("y2",ly);
      yl.setAttribute("stroke","#e5e7eb");yl.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.5");svg.appendChild(yl);
    }
    addLine(svg,0,CY,W,CY,"#9ca3af","1");
    addLine(svg,CX,0,CX,H,"#9ca3af","1");
    addText(svg,6,14,label,"#1f2937","11");
    return svg;
  }

  function buildViz(fn, z0x, z0y, a1, a2) {
    const svgL = makeSVG("z-plane");
    const svgR = makeSVG("w-plane");

    const ARM_LEN = 0.9; // in complex units

    // Arm end-points in z-plane
    const z1r = z0x + ARM_LEN*Math.cos(a1), z1i = z0y + ARM_LEN*Math.sin(a1);
    const z2r = z0x + ARM_LEN*Math.cos(a2), z2i = z0y + ARM_LEN*Math.sin(a2);

    // Draw z-plane arms
    const [z0sx,z0sy] = toScreen(z0x,z0y,CX,CY,SCALE);
    const [z1sx,z1sy] = toScreen(z1r,z1i,CX,CY,SCALE);
    const [z2sx,z2sy] = toScreen(z2r,z2i,CX,CY,SCALE);
    addLine(svgL,z0sx,z0sy,z1sx,z1sy,"#f97316","2.5");
    addLine(svgL,z0sx,z0sy,z2sx,z2sy,"#8b5cf6","2.5");
    addCircle(svgL,z0sx,z0sy,6,"#f97316");
    addText(svgL,z0sx+8,z0sy-6,"z₀","#f97316","12");

    // Input angle between arms
    const inputAngle = a2 - a1;

    // Map z₀ and arm endpoints
    const [w0r,w0i] = evalF(fn,z0x,z0y);
    const [w1r,w1i] = evalF(fn,z1r,z1i);
    const [w2r,w2i] = evalF(fn,z2r,z2i);

    // Auto-scale w-plane around w₀
    const d1 = Math.sqrt((w1r-w0r)**2+(w1i-w0i)**2);
    const d2 = Math.sqrt((w2r-w0r)**2+(w2i-w0i)**2);
    const maxD = Math.max(d1,d2,0.1);
    const wSCALE = Math.min(SCALE, 80/(maxD));
    const wCX = W/2 - w0r*wSCALE, wCY = H/2 + w0i*wSCALE;

    function toWS(re,im){ return [wCX+re*wSCALE, wCY-im*wSCALE]; }

    if (isFinite(w0r) && isFinite(w0i)) {
      const [w0sx,w0sy]=toWS(w0r,w0i);
      const [w1sx,w1sy]=toWS(w1r,w1i);
      const [w2sx,w2sy]=toWS(w2r,w2i);
      addLine(svgR,w0sx,w0sy,w1sx,w1sy,"#f97316","2.5");
      addLine(svgR,w0sx,w0sy,w2sx,w2sy,"#8b5cf6","2.5");
      addCircle(svgR,w0sx,w0sy,6,"#f97316");
      addText(svgR,w0sx+8,w0sy-6,"f(z₀)","#3b82f6","11");

      // Output angle between arm images
      const out1 = Math.atan2(w1i-w0i, w1r-w0r);
      const out2 = Math.atan2(w2i-w0i, w2r-w0r);
      let outputAngle = out2 - out1;
      while (outputAngle >  Math.PI) outputAngle -= 2*Math.PI;
      while (outputAngle < -Math.PI) outputAngle += 2*Math.PI;
      let inputAngleN = inputAngle;
      while (inputAngleN >  Math.PI) inputAngleN -= 2*Math.PI;
      while (inputAngleN < -Math.PI) inputAngleN += 2*Math.PI;

      // Derivative magnitude for critical-point test
      const [fpRe,fpIm] = evalFPrime(fn,z0x,z0y);
      const fpMag = Math.sqrt(fpRe*fpRe+fpIm*fpIm);
      const isCritical = fpMag < 0.05;
      const isConj = fn === "f(z) = z̄";
      const angleDiff = Math.abs(Math.abs(outputAngle)-Math.abs(inputAngleN));
      const isConformal = !isCritical && !isConj && angleDiff < 0.15;

      // Status badge
      let statusColor, statusMsg;
      if (isCritical) { statusColor="#dc2626"; statusMsg="Critical point: f'(z₀)≈0 — conformality fails"; }
      else if (isConj) { statusColor="#dc2626"; statusMsg="f=z̄: reflection — angles reversed (not conformal)"; }
      else if (isConformal) { statusColor="#059669"; statusMsg="Conformal: angles preserved"; }
      else { statusColor="#dc2626"; statusMsg="Angle mismatch — check critical point or branch"; }

      const badge=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"rect");
      badge.setAttribute("x","4"); badge.setAttribute("y",H-26);
      badge.setAttribute("width",W-8); badge.setAttribute("height","22");
      badge.setAttribute("fill",statusColor); badge.setAttribute("rx","4"); badge.setAttribute("opacity","0.15");
      svgR.appendChild(badge);
      const badgeTxt=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
      badgeTxt.setAttribute("x","8"); badgeTxt.setAttribute("y",H-11);
      badgeTxt.setAttribute("fill",statusColor); badgeTxt.setAttribute("font-size","9.5");
      badgeTxt.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif"); badgeTxt.textContent=statusMsg;
      svgR.appendChild(badgeTxt);

      // Angle readout in w-plane
      addText(svgR,6,H-32,`input angle: ${(inputAngleN*180/Math.PI).toFixed(1)}°  →  output: ${(outputAngle*180/Math.PI).toFixed(1)}°`,"#374151","9.5");
    } else {
      addText(svgR,W/2-40,H/2,"(pole — undefined)","#dc2626","11");
    }

    const wrap=document.createElement("div");
    wrap.style.cssText="display:flex; gap:0.75rem; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:0.5rem 0;";
    wrap.appendChild(svgL); wrap.appendChild(svgR);
    return wrap;
  }

  const container=document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText="border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem; margin:1rem 0;";

  const titleEl=document.createElement("div");
  titleEl.style.cssText="font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.5rem; font-family:sans-serif;";
  titleEl.textContent="Conformal mapping: angle-preservation test";
  container.appendChild(titleEl);
  container.appendChild(funcSel);
  container.appendChild(z0xSl);
  container.appendChild(z0ySl);
  container.appendChild(arm1Sl);
  container.appendChild(arm2Sl);

  const vizDiv=document.createElement("div"); container.appendChild(vizDiv);

  const noteEl=document.createElement("div");
  noteEl.style.cssText="margin-top:0.4rem; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
  noteEl.textContent="Orange and purple arms cross at z₀ in the left panel. Their images cross at f(z₀) in the right panel. The angle between the images (bottom of right panel) equals the input angle when f is conformal. Move z₀ onto a critical point (f′(z₀) = 0, e.g. z₀ = 0 for f = z²) to see conformality fail. Select f = z̄ to see that a reflection reverses angles instead of preserving them.";
  container.appendChild(noteEl);

  function update() {
    vizDiv.innerHTML="";
    vizDiv.appendChild(buildViz(funcSel.value, z0xSl.value, z0ySl.value, arm1Sl.value, arm2Sl.value));
  }
  funcSel.addEventListener("input",update);
  z0xSl.addEventListener("input",update);
  z0ySl.addEventListener("input",update);
  arm1Sl.addEventListener("input",update);
  arm2Sl.addEventListener("input",update);
  update();

  return container;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function makeStepperHTML(steps) {
  let current = 0;
  const totalSteps = steps.length;
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.style.cssText = "border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:8px; padding:1rem 1.25rem; margin:0.75rem 0; font-family:inherit;";
  const stepsDiv = document.createElement("div");
  stepsDiv.style.marginBottom = "0.75rem";
  function renderSteps() {
    stepsDiv.innerHTML = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < current; i++) {
      const s = steps[i];
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.style.cssText = "display:grid; grid-template-columns:220px 1fr; gap:0.35rem 1rem; align-items:baseline; padding:0.35rem 0; border-top:1px solid #f3f4f6;";
      const opCell = document.createElement("span");
      opCell.style.cssText = "font-size:0.85em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic;";
      opCell.textContent = s.op;
      const eqCell = document.createElement("span");
      eqCell.innerHTML = katex.renderToString(s.eq, { throwOnError: false, displayMode: false });
      row.appendChild(opCell); row.appendChild(eqCell);
      if (s.note) {
        const noteRow = document.createElement("div");
        noteRow.style.cssText = "grid-column:2; font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; padding-bottom:0.2rem;";
        noteRow.textContent = s.note;
        row.appendChild(noteRow);
      }
      stepsDiv.appendChild(row);
    }
    if (current === totalSteps) {
      const done = document.createElement("div");
      done.style.cssText = "margin-top:0.5rem; font-size:0.9em; color:#059669; font-weight:500;";
      done.textContent = "Solution complete.";
      stepsDiv.appendChild(done);
    }
  }
  const controls = document.createElement("div");
  controls.style.cssText = "display:flex; gap:0.5rem; align-items:center;";
  const nextBtn = document.createElement("button");
  nextBtn.textContent = "Next step →";
  nextBtn.style.cssText = "padding:0.42rem 0.95rem; border:1px solid #2563eb; border-radius:5px; background:#2563eb; color:#ffffff; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.9em; font-weight:600; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(37,99,235,0.18);";
  const resetBtn = document.createElement("button");
  resetBtn.textContent = "Reset";
  resetBtn.style.cssText = "padding:0.42rem 0.8rem; border:1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius:5px; background:#f8fafc; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.9em; color:#475569; font-weight:500;";
  const counter = document.createElement("span");
  counter.style.cssText = "font-size:0.82em; color:#9ca3af; margin-left:0.25rem;";
  function updateButtons() {
    nextBtn.disabled = current === totalSteps;
    nextBtn.style.opacity = current === totalSteps ? "0.4" : "1";
    counter.textContent = current === 0 ? "Click to reveal steps" : `Step ${current} of ${totalSteps}`;
  }
  nextBtn.onclick = () => { if (current < totalSteps) { current++; renderSteps(); updateButtons(); } };
  resetBtn.onclick = () => { current = 0; renderSteps(); updateButtons(); };
  controls.appendChild(nextBtn); controls.appendChild(resetBtn); controls.appendChild(counter);
  container.appendChild(stepsDiv); container.appendChild(controls);
  renderSteps(); updateButtons();
  return container;
}
```

### Exercise 1: Cauchy-Riemann equations for $f(z) = z^2$

Verify that $f(z) = z^2$ satisfies the Cauchy-Riemann equations everywhere and compute $f'(z)$.

<!-- STEPPER -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
makeStepperHTML([
  {
    op: "Expand in terms of x and y",
    eq: "(x+iy)^2 = x^2 - y^2 + 2ixy \\implies u = x^2-y^2,\\quad v = 2xy"
  },
  {
    op: "Check u_x = v_y",
    eq: "u_x = 2x, \\quad v_y = 2x \\implies u_x = v_y \\checkmark"
  },
  {
    op: "Check u_y = −v_x",
    eq: "u_y = -2y, \\quad v_x = 2y \\implies u_y = -v_x \\checkmark"
  },
  {
    op: "Partial derivatives continuous everywhere → f is entire",
    eq: "f'(z) = u_x + iv_x = 2x + 2iy = 2(x+iy) = 2z",
    note: "Same power rule as real calculus. The formal rules d(z^n)/dz = nz^{n−1} hold for all integer n."
  }
])
```

### Exercise 2: Finding a harmonic conjugate

Show that $u = x^3 - 3xy^2$ is harmonic, find its harmonic conjugate $v$, and identify the analytic function $f = u + iv$.

<!-- STEPPER -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
makeStepperHTML([
  {
    op: "Verify Laplace's equation",
    eq: "u_{xx} = 6x, \\quad u_{yy} = -6x \\implies \\nabla^2 u = 0 \\checkmark"
  },
  {
    op: "C-R gives v_y = u_x = 3x²−3y²; integrate w.r.t. y",
    eq: "v = 3x^2 y - y^3 + g(x)"
  },
  {
    op: "C-R gives v_x = −u_y; differentiate v and set equal",
    eq: "v_x = 6xy + g'(x) = -u_y = 6xy \\implies g'(x) = 0 \\implies g = C"
  },
  {
    op: "Identify f(z)",
    eq: "f(z) = (x^3-3xy^2) + i(3x^2y-y^3) + iC = z^3 + iC",
    note: "Expand z³ = (x+iy)³ to verify: real part is x³−3xy², imaginary part is 3x²y−y³."
  }
])
```

### Exercise 3: $e^z$ is entire

Verify the Cauchy-Riemann equations for $f(z) = e^z$ and confirm $\frac{d}{dz}e^z = e^z$.

<!-- STEPPER -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
makeStepperHTML([
  {
    op: "Write e^z in terms of u and v",
    eq: "e^z = e^x(\\cos y + i\\sin y) \\implies u = e^x\\cos y,\\quad v = e^x\\sin y"
  },
  {
    op: "Check u_x = v_y",
    eq: "u_x = e^x\\cos y, \\quad v_y = e^x\\cos y \\checkmark"
  },
  {
    op: "Check u_y = −v_x",
    eq: "u_y = -e^x\\sin y, \\quad -v_x = -e^x\\sin y \\checkmark"
  },
  {
    op: "Compute the derivative",
    eq: "\\frac{d}{dz}e^z = u_x + iv_x = e^x\\cos y + ie^x\\sin y = e^z",
    note: "The exponential is its own derivative — as in real analysis."
  }
])
```

### Exercise 4: Where is $f(z) = |z|^2$ differentiable?

<!-- STEPPER -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
makeStepperHTML([
  {
    op: "Write |z|² = x²+y², so u = x²+y², v = 0",
    eq: "u_x = 2x, \\quad v_y = 0 \\implies \\text{C-R requires } x = 0"
  },
  {
    op: "Second C-R equation",
    eq: "u_y = 2y, \\quad -v_x = 0 \\implies \\text{C-R requires } y = 0"
  },
  {
    op: "C-R equations hold only at the origin",
    eq: "f \\text{ is differentiable only at } z = 0, \\text{ with } f'(0) = 0"
  },
  {
    op: "Differentiability at a single point ≠ analytic",
    eq: "|z|^2 \\text{ is nowhere analytic}",
    note: "Analyticity requires differentiability in an open disk. A single point of differentiability is not enough."
  }
])
```

### Exercise 5: Powers via De Moivre

Computing roots and powers in polar form — a technique used throughout this volume, including when locating poles and computing residues.

Compute $(1+i)^8$ and find all fourth roots of $-16$.

<!-- STEPPER -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
makeStepperHTML([
  {
    op: "Convert 1+i to polar",
    eq: "1+i = \\sqrt{2}\\,e^{i\\pi/4}"
  },
  {
    op: "Raise to the 8th power",
    eq: "(1+i)^8 = (\\sqrt{2})^8 e^{i8\\pi/4} = 16\\,e^{2\\pi i} = 16",
    note: "e^{2πi} = 1."
  },
  {
    op: "Write −16 in polar form",
    eq: "-16 = 16\\,e^{i\\pi}"
  },
  {
    op: "Fourth roots: take r^{1/4} and divide argument by 4, adding kπ/2 for k=0,1,2,3",
    eq: "z_k = 2\\,e^{i(\\pi/4 + k\\pi/2)}, \\quad k = 0,1,2,3"
  },
  {
    op: "List the four roots",
    eq: "z_0 = \\sqrt{2}(1+i), \\quad z_1 = \\sqrt{2}(-1+i), \\quad z_2 = \\sqrt{2}(-1-i), \\quad z_3 = \\sqrt{2}(1-i)",
    note: "The four roots form the vertices of a square centred at the origin with circumradius 2."
  }
])
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  // De Moivre roots: static diagram — four fourth roots of −16
  // Orange dots on circle of radius 2, arguments labelled
  const W = 300, H = 300, SCALE = 90, CX = W/2, CY = H/2;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  const svg=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"svg");
  svg.setAttribute("width",W); svg.setAttribute("height",H);
  svg.style.cssText="background:#fafafa; border:1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius:6px; display:block;";

  function toS(re,im){ return [CX+re*SCALE, CY-im*SCALE]; }

  // Grid
  for(let i=-2;i<=2;i++){
    const xl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line"); const [lx]=toS(i,0);
    xl.setAttribute("x1",lx);xl.setAttribute("y1","0");xl.setAttribute("x2",lx);xl.setAttribute("y2",H);
    xl.setAttribute("stroke","#e5e7eb");xl.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.5");svg.appendChild(xl);
    const yl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line"); const [,ly]=toS(0,i);
    yl.setAttribute("x1","0");yl.setAttribute("y1",ly);yl.setAttribute("x2",W);yl.setAttribute("y2",ly);
    yl.setAttribute("stroke","#e5e7eb");yl.setAttribute("stroke-width","0.5");svg.appendChild(yl);
  }

  // Axes
  const [ox,oy]=toS(0,0);
  function axLine(x1,y1,x2,y2){ const l=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line"); l.setAttribute("x1",x1);l.setAttribute("y1",y1);l.setAttribute("x2",x2);l.setAttribute("y2",y2); l.setAttribute("stroke","#9ca3af");l.setAttribute("stroke-width","1");svg.appendChild(l); }
  const [ax1]=toS(-2.3,0); const [ax2]=toS(2.3,0); axLine(ax1,oy,ax2,oy);
  const [,ay1]=toS(0,-2.3); const [,ay2]=toS(0,2.3); axLine(ox,ay1,ox,ay2);

  // Circle of radius 2
  const circ=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"circle");
  circ.setAttribute("cx",CX); circ.setAttribute("cy",CY); circ.setAttribute("r",(2*SCALE).toString());
  circ.setAttribute("fill","none"); circ.setAttribute("stroke","#d1d5db"); circ.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");
  svg.appendChild(circ);

  // Radius label
  const rLbl=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
  rLbl.setAttribute("x",CX+4); rLbl.setAttribute("y",CY-(2*SCALE)+14);
  rLbl.setAttribute("fill","#9ca3af"); rLbl.setAttribute("font-size","10");
  rLbl.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif"); rLbl.textContent="|z| = 2"; svg.appendChild(rLbl);

  // The four roots: z_k = 2·e^{i(π/4 + kπ/2)}, k=0,1,2,3
  const r=2;
  const roots=[
    { k:0, arg: Math.PI/4,       label:"z₀ = √2(1+i)",   argLabel:"π/4" },
    { k:1, arg: 3*Math.PI/4,     label:"z₁ = √2(−1+i)",  argLabel:"3π/4" },
    { k:2, arg: 5*Math.PI/4,     label:"z₂ = √2(−1−i)",  argLabel:"5π/4" },
    { k:3, arg: 7*Math.PI/4,     label:"z₃ = √2(1−i)",   argLabel:"7π/4" }
  ];

  roots.forEach(({ arg, label, argLabel },idx) => {
    const re=r*Math.cos(arg), im=r*Math.sin(arg);
    const [sx,sy]=toS(re,im);

    // Spoke
    const spoke=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"line");
    spoke.setAttribute("x1",ox); spoke.setAttribute("y1",oy);
    spoke.setAttribute("x2",sx); spoke.setAttribute("y2",sy);
    spoke.setAttribute("stroke","#fdba74"); spoke.setAttribute("stroke-width","1");
    spoke.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray","4,3"); svg.appendChild(spoke);

    // Dot
    const dot=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"circle");
    dot.setAttribute("cx",sx); dot.setAttribute("cy",sy); dot.setAttribute("r","7");
    dot.setAttribute("fill","#f97316"); dot.setAttribute("stroke","#fff"); dot.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");
    svg.appendChild(dot);

    // Root label
    const dx = re >= 0 ? 10 : -10;
    const anchor = re >= 0 ? "start" : "end";
    const dyLbl = im >= 0 ? -10 : 16;
    const lt=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
    lt.setAttribute("x",sx+dx); lt.setAttribute("y",sy+dyLbl);
    lt.setAttribute("fill","#f97316"); lt.setAttribute("font-size","10.5");
    lt.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif"); lt.setAttribute("text-anchor",anchor);
    lt.textContent=label; svg.appendChild(lt);

    // Argument label on the arc
    const arcR=32+idx*8;
    const midAng=arg*0.9+0.05;
    const alx=CX+arcR*Math.cos(midAng-Math.PI*0.08);
    const aly=CY-arcR*Math.sin(midAng-Math.PI*0.08);
    const at=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
    at.setAttribute("x",alx); at.setAttribute("y",aly);
    at.setAttribute("fill","#8b5cf6"); at.setAttribute("font-size","9");
    at.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif"); at.setAttribute("text-anchor","middle");
    at.textContent=argLabel; svg.appendChild(at);
  });

  // Origin
  const orig=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"circle");
  orig.setAttribute("cx",ox); orig.setAttribute("cy",oy); orig.setAttribute("r","4");
  orig.setAttribute("fill","#6b7280"); orig.setAttribute("stroke","#fff"); orig.setAttribute("stroke-width","1.5");
  svg.appendChild(orig);

  // Title
  const titleT=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text");
  titleT.setAttribute("x","6"); titleT.setAttribute("y","14");
  titleT.setAttribute("fill","#1f2937"); titleT.setAttribute("font-size","11");
  titleT.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif"); titleT.setAttribute("font-weight","bold");
  titleT.textContent="Fourth roots of −16"; svg.appendChild(titleT);

  // Axis labels
  const reL=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text"); reL.setAttribute("x",ax2-18);reL.setAttribute("y",oy-5);
  reL.setAttribute("fill","#6b7280");reL.setAttribute("font-size","10");reL.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");reL.textContent="Re";svg.appendChild(reL);
  const imL=document.createElementNS(svgNS,"text"); imL.setAttribute("x",ox+5);imL.setAttribute("y",ay2+12);
  imL.setAttribute("fill","#6b7280");imL.setAttribute("font-size","10");imL.setAttribute("font-family","sans-serif");imL.textContent="Im";svg.appendChild(imL);

  const wrap=document.createElement("div"); wrap.style.cssText="margin:0.75rem 0;";
  wrap.appendChild(svg);
  const note=document.createElement("div");
  note.style.cssText="font-size:0.82em; color:#6b7280; font-style:italic; margin-top:0.3rem; max-width:300px;";
  note.textContent="The four fourth roots of −16 sit at the vertices of a square of circumradius 2. Spaced π/2 apart in argument — each separated by 90°.";
  wrap.appendChild(note);
  return wrap;
}
```

<!-- STUDENT REVIEW
## Chapter 01 — Complex functions
Layer: engineering

### Confusion points

1. **arg z used before defined** (§ Complex numbers: brief review, Polar form). The symbol `arg z` appears in body text before it is defined; `notation_introduced` lists it but a reader who didn't read the front matter carefully will encounter it cold.

2. **C-R derivation: both limit steps are skipped** (§ Deriving the Cauchy-Riemann equations). The chapter states the horizontal approach gives `u_x + iv_x` and the vertical gives `v_y − iu_y`, but shows no algebra. Expanding `(f(z)−f(z₀))/(z−z₀)` with a real or purely-imaginary increment, separating real/imaginary parts, and dividing by `i` are not obvious. A reader doing this for the first time needs at least one worked-out limit.

3. **"Simply connected domain" undefined** (§ Harmonic functions). Used here and repeated in Chapter 2 without definition. Engineers may have an informal picture but the term deserves one sentence of explanation on first use.

4. **"Branch cut" unexplained** (§ Logarithm). The branch cut is named and its location given but no explanation of what it does (discontinuity in Arg z) or why it exists. This is the first exposure to branch cuts anywhere in the series.

5. **"Conformal" introduced as a forward reference without context** (§ Conformal mappings: preview). The word is used without the prior sentence flagging that this is a preview of Chapter 4. A reader might not realise this is deferred material.

### Reassurance gaps

- After the C-R equations are derived, there is no verification moment: the reader is not asked to check the equations for a simple case before moving on to the harmonic function consequence. Exercise 1 covers `f(z) = z²` but comes late. A sentence saying "check this now against the example in the previous section" would help.

- The note "Being differentiable at an isolated point does not make a function analytic" (§ Analytic functions) uses `|z|²` as the example but that example is Exercise 4, several pages away. The connection should point forward explicitly.

### Exercise calibration

- Exercises 1–4 are well-calibrated for the engineering layer. Exercise 5 (De Moivre) is noticeably easier than the C-R exercises and sits at a lower conceptual level; it feels like a warm-up that belongs earlier, not at the end.
- All five exercises have clean answers. Exercise 2 (harmonic conjugate) is the most challenging and the most useful for engineering readers — good placement as Exercise 2.

### Wayfinding

- `opens_to` lists "Complex integration and residues" — this covers Chapters 2 and 3 but does not mention Chapter 4 (Conformal mapping). A reader finishing this chapter won't know Chapter 4 is also in their near future.

## Verdict: READABLE WITH FIXES

The chapter is largely followable for an engineering-layer reader. The C-R derivation is the main comprehension barrier: the algebra is skipped at exactly the moment a new reader most needs to see it. The undefined "simply connected" and unexplained "branch cut" are secondary friction points.
-->
